			"Hold {0} 0.5s: Arcade | Hold {1} 0.5s: Camera", Input Binding String(Button(Melee)), Input Binding String(Button(Interact))) : Player Variable(Local Player,
			IndeksBahasa) == 1 ? Custom String("Tahan {0} 0,5 dtk: Menu | Tahan {1} 0,5 dtk: Kamera", Input Binding String(Button(Melee)), Input Binding String(Button(Interact))) : Custom String(

			Player Variable(Local Player, IndeksBahasa) == 0 ? Custom String("Host:") : Player Variable(Local Player, IndeksBahasa) == 1 ? Custom String("Host:") : Custom String("โฮสต์:"), Hero Icon String(Hero Of(Host Player)),
			And(Player Variable(Host Player, NamaTampilan) != Null, Player Variable(Host Player, NamaTampilan) != Custom String("")) ? Player Variable(Host Player, NamaTampilan) : Custom String("{0}", Host Player)) : Custom String(""),
			Right, 0, Color(White), Color(White), Global.RGB, Visible To String and Color, Visible Never);
		"Ikon asli di tujuan mengikuti RGB nama masing-masing; maksimum dua belas pemilik."

rule("00a1 - Umum: Mulai mode segera saat menunggu pemain")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Global.ModeMulaiDiminta == False;
		Is Game In Progress == False;
		Is Waiting For Players == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Permintaan mulai hanya boleh dikirim sekali sampai pertandingan berikutnya."
		Global.ModeMulaiDiminta = True;
		Start Game Mode;
	}
}

rule("00a2 - Umum: Lewati pemilihan pahlawan")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Global.PilihPahlawanDilewati == False;
		Count Of(Global.PemainManusia) == 0;
		Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Null;
		Is Game In Progress == False;
		Is Assembling Heroes == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Khusus inisialisasi awal: tutup fase pemilihan pahlawan sekali saja."
		Global.PilihPahlawanDilewati = True;
		Set Match Time(0);
	}
}

rule("00a3 - Umum: Lewati persiapan awal")

	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Global.PersiapanDilewati == False;
		Count Of(Global.PemainManusia) == 0;
		Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Null;
		Is Game In Progress == False;
		Is In Setup == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Khusus inisialisasi awal: tutup fase persiapan pertandingan sekali saja."
		Global.PersiapanDilewati = True;
		Set Match Time(0);
	}
}

	{

	}

	actions
	{
		"Setelah mode berjalan, pelewatan fase awal dikunci agar pindah tim tidak memicu Set Match Time(0)."
		Global.PilihPahlawanDilewati = True;
		Global.PersiapanDilewati = True;
	}
}

rule("00c - Umum: Mulai ulang tepat sekali saat hitung mundur habis")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Global.MulaiUlangSudahDiminta == False;
		Global.SisaWaktuServer <= 0;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Kunci mencegah beberapa aksi mulai ulang pada langkah yang sama; tidak ada pemenang atau skor yang diumumkan."
		Global.MulaiUlangSudahDiminta = True;
		Global.PilihPahlawanDilewati = False;
		Global.PersiapanDilewati = False;
		Global.ModeMulaiDiminta = False;
		Restart Match;
	}
}

rule("01a - Siklus tim: Karantina sebelum penyiapan ulang")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.TimTerakhir != Team Of(Event Player);
	}

	actions
	{
		"Karantina ringan: tunda pembersihan penuh sampai transisi tim bawaan stabil."
		Event Player.PembaruanDaftarTertunda = False;
		Event Player.PindahTimDiproses = True;
		Event Player.SiklusPemainAktif = True;
		Event Player.SudahSiap = False;
		Event Player.Manusia = False;
		"Hentikan animasi ikon milik pemain dan cabut pukulan sebelum menunggu tim stabil; pengenal dibersihkan pekerja serial."
		Global.PemainPukulanSuper = Remove From Array(Global.PemainPukulanSuper, Event Player);
		If(Entity Exists(Event Player) == True);
			Stop Chasing Player Variable(Event Player, PosisiIkonPilar);
		End;
		Event Player.TimTerakhir = Team Of(Event Player);
		Event Player.TimSiklusTarget = Team Of(Event Player);
		Event Player.WaktuSiklusTim = Total Time Elapsed + 0.500;
		If(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Event Player);
			Global.PemainSiklusGlobal = Null;
			Global.WaktuSiklusGlobal = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
		End;
	}
}

rule("01b - Siklus tim: Pekerja penyiapan dari penjadwal global")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Entity Exists(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.Manusia == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Event Player.PindahTimDiproses == True;
		Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Event Player;
		Event Player.TimSiklusTarget == Team Of(Event Player);
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.SudahSiap == False;
		Total Time Elapsed >= Event Player.WaktuSiklusTim;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Pisahkan pemulihan mesin, pelepasan pengenal, dan penyiapan; batalkan bila identitas, tim, atau reservasi berubah."
		Call Subroutine(TenangkanPemain);
		Wait(0.050, Abort When False);
		Abort If(Global.Siap == False);
		Abort If(Entity Exists(Event Player) == False);
		Abort If(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True);
		Abort If(Event Player.BotOtomatis == True);
		Abort If(Event Player.Manusia == True);
		Abort If(Event Player.PindahTimDiproses == False);
		Abort If(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal != Event Player);
		Abort If(Event Player.TimSiklusTarget != Team Of(Event Player));
		Abort If(Has Spawned(Event Player) == False);
		Abort If(Event Player.SudahSiap == True);
		Abort If(Total Time Elapsed < Event Player.WaktuSiklusTim);
		If(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player));
			Call Subroutine(BersihkanPemain);
		End;
		Wait(0.050, Abort When False);
		Abort If(Global.Siap == False);
		Abort If(Entity Exists(Event Player) == False);
		Abort If(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True);
		Abort If(Event Player.BotOtomatis == True);
		Abort If(Event Player.Manusia == True);
		Abort If(Event Player.PindahTimDiproses == False);
		Abort If(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal != Event Player);
		Abort If(Event Player.TimSiklusTarget != Team Of(Event Player));
		Abort If(Has Spawned(Event Player) == False);
		Abort If(Event Player.SudahSiap == True);
		Abort If(Total Time Elapsed < Event Player.WaktuSiklusTim);
		Call Subroutine(SiapkanPemain);
	}
}

rule("02 - Pemain: Pisahkan manusia dari pasukan kaleng")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.SudahSiap == True;
		Event Player.SiklusPemainAktif == False;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.TimTerakhir == Team Of(Event Player);
		Event Player.PembaruanDaftarTertunda == False;
		Event Player.SudahDiperiksa == False;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.SudahDiperiksa = True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis = False;
		Event Player.Manusia = False;
		Event Player.WarnaNama = Color(White);
		If(And(Event Player.PernahDisiapkan == True, And(Event Player.NamaTampilan != Null, Event Player.NamaTampilan != Custom String(""))));
			"Gunakan nama tersimpan saat pindah tim agar pemain manusia terdaftar tidak terjebak pemeriksaan iBot."
		Else;
			Start Forcing Dummy Bot Name(Event Player, Custom String("​"));
			Wait(0.016, Ignore Condition);
			Abort If(Entity Exists(Event Player) == False);
			If(Or(Event Player.SudahSiap == False, Has Spawned(Event Player) == False));
				Stop Forcing Dummy Bot Name(Event Player);
				Event Player.SudahDiperiksa = False;
				Abort;
			End;
			If(Custom String("{0}", Event Player) == Custom String("​"));
				Event Player.BotOtomatis = True;
			End;
			Stop Forcing Dummy Bot Name(Event Player);
		End;
		If(Event Player.BotOtomatis == True);
			"Bot mati tetap melepas antrean; aturan 03c mengunci bot saat hidup kembali."
			Event Player.PindahTimDiproses = False;
			Event Player.SiklusPemainAktif = False;
			Event Player.WaktuSiklusTim = 0;
			If(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Event Player);
				Global.PemainSiklusGlobal = Null;
				Global.WaktuSiklusGlobal = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			End;
			Cancel Primary Action(Event Player);
			Call Subroutine(KunciBot);
			Abort;
		End;

		Abort If(Entity Exists(Event Player) == False);
		Abort If(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player));
		If(Count Of(Global.SlotHUDTersedia) == 0);
			Event Player.SudahDiperiksa = False;
			Event Player.SudahSiap = False;
			Event Player.PindahTimDiproses = False;
			Event Player.SiklusPemainAktif = False;
			Event Player.WaktuSiklusTim = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			If(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Event Player);
				Global.PemainSiklusGlobal = Null;
				Global.WaktuSiklusGlobal = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			End;
			Abort;
		End;
		"Nama tersimpan yang sudah valid tidak boleh ditimpa teks kosong saat transisi tim."
		If(Or(Event Player.PernahDisiapkan == False, Or(Event Player.NamaTampilan == Null, Event Player.NamaTampilan == Custom String(""))));
			Event Player.NamaTampilan = Evaluate Once(Custom String("{0}", Event Player));
		End;
		If(Or(Event Player.NamaTampilan == Null, Event Player.NamaTampilan == Custom String("")));
			"Nama manusia yang masih kosong belum merupakan identitas stabil: jangan pakai slot daftar pemain dan jadwalkan ulang penyiapan ringan."
			Event Player.SudahDiperiksa = False;
			Event Player.SudahSiap = False;
			Event Player.WaktuSiklusTim = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			If(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Event Player);
				Global.PemainSiklusGlobal = Null;
				Global.WaktuSiklusGlobal = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			End;
			Abort;
		End;
		"Sembunyikan bilah, objektif, dan ikon mode tanpa mengganggu HUD pahlawan serta HUD buatan kita."
		Disable Game Mode HUD(Event Player);
		Disable Game Mode In-World UI(Event Player);
		Event Player.IndeksGenre = -1;
		Event Player.IndeksWarna = 0;
		Event Player.WarnaNama = Global.DaftarWarna[Event Player.IndeksWarna];
		If(Event Player.NamaTampilan == Custom String("งูแรร์"));
			Event Player.MusikKhusus = Custom String("Draconian");
			Event Player.IndeksWarna = 2;
			Event Player.KursorWarna = 2;
			Event Player.WarnaNama = Global.DaftarWarna[2];
			Event Player.WarnaMenu = Global.DaftarWarnaRGB[2];
			Event Player.IndeksIkon = 23;
			Event Player.KursorIkon = 23;
		End;
		Event Player.UrutanHUD = First Of(Global.SlotHUDTersedia);
		Global.WaktuPukulanSuper[Event Player.UrutanHUD] = 0;
		Global.SlotHUDTerakhir = Max(Global.SlotHUDTerakhir, Event Player.UrutanHUD);
		Modify Global Variable(SlotHUDTersedia, Remove From Array By Index, 0);
		Global.PemainManusia = Append To Array(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player);
		Disable Nameplates(Event Player, Filtered Array(Global.PemainManusia, Player Variable(Current Array Element, PelatNamaDinonaktifkan) == True));

		Global.HudKiriPemain = Append To Array(Global.HudKiriPemain, 0);
		Global.HudMenuPemain = Append To Array(Global.HudMenuPemain, 0);
		Global.TeksDuniaPemain = Append To Array(Global.TeksDuniaPemain, 0);
		Global.SlotHUDPemain = Append To Array(Global.SlotHUDPemain, Event Player.UrutanHUD);
		Event Player.Manusia = True;
		Event Player.PahlawanTerakhir = Hero Of(Event Player);
		Global.PilihanPerluDihitung = True;

		"Klasifikasi manusia dan bot sudah selesai. HUD pemain dibuat sekali pada keadaan muncul yang stabil."
		Create HUD Text(Global.PemainManusia, Null, Custom String("{0} {1} {2}", Global.DaftarIkon[Event Player.IndeksIkon],
			Hero Icon String(Is Duplicating(Event Player) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Event Player) : Hero Of(Event Player)), Custom String("{0} - {1}", Evaluate Once(Event Player.NamaTampilan),
			Event Player.MusikKhusus != Null ? Event Player.MusikKhusus : Event Player.IndeksGenre >= 0 ? Global.DaftarGenre[Event Player.IndeksGenre] : Player Variable(Local Player, IndeksBahasa) == 0 ? Custom String("no soundtrack yet")
			: Player Variable(Local Player, IndeksBahasa) == 1 ? Custom String("belum pilih musik") : Custom String("ยังไม่เลือกเพลง"))), And(Global.DiagnostikPerforma == True, And(Local Player == Host Player, Event Player.UrutanHUD == Global.SlotHUDTerakhir)) ? Custom String("{0}\n{1}",
			Player Variable(Local Player, IndeksBahasa) == 2 ? Custom String("\n \nโหลด {0}% | เฉลี่ย {1}% | สูงสุด {2}%", Server Load,
			Server Load Average, Server Load Peak) : Player Variable(Local Player, IndeksBahasa) == 1 ? Custom String(
			"\n \nBEBAN {0}% | RATA {1}% | PUNCAK {2}%", Server Load, Server Load Average, Server Load Peak) : Custom String(
			"\n \nLOAD {0}% | AVG {1}% | MAX {2}%", Server Load, Server Load Average, Server Load Peak), Custom String("HUD {0} | IWT {1}",
			9 + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.HudKiriPemain, Current Array Element != 0)) + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.HudMenuPemain, Current Array Element != 0)) + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.HudEfekSementara, Current Array Element != 0)), Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.TeksDuniaPemain, Current Array Element != 0)) + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.TeksTeleportasiSementara, Current Array Element != 0)) + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.TeksVisiSementara, Current Array Element != 0)))) : Custom String(""), Left, 1 + Event Player.UrutanHUD, Color(White), Event Player.WarnaNama, Color(White), Visible To String and Color, Visible Never);
		Event Player.HudKiri = Last Text ID;
		If(And(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) >= 0, Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.HudKiriPemain)));
			Global.HudKiriPemain[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player)] = Event Player.HudKiri;
		End;
		Event Player.HudPemainDibuat = True;
		Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String(
			"Welcome to Cozywatch! Pick a vibe & color. Stay weird.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String(
			"Selamat datang di Cozywatch! Pilih musik & warna. Santai!") : Custom String(
			"ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ Cozywatch เลือกเพลง เลือกสี แล้วกวนแบบพอดี ๆ"));
	}
}

rule("03c - Bot: Kunci saat hidup kembali atau pahlawan berganti")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Or(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player), Event Player.BotOtomatis) == True;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Or(Event Player.KunciBotAktif == False, Hero Of(Event Player) != Event Player.PahlawanTerakhir) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Call Subroutine(KunciBot);
		If(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True);
			Event Player.WaktuTeleportasiBotBuatan = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
			Event Player.KursorTeleportasiBotBuatan = 0;
			Set Respawn Max Time(Event Player, 3);
		End;
	}
}

rule("03d - Subrutin: Rawat slot bot buatan kedua tim 1 Hz")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RawatBotBuatan;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Global.Siap == False);
		Abort If(Is Game In Progress == False);
		Abort If(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal != Null);
		"Utamakan slot pemain; beri jeda percobaan tiap tim sebelum membuat bot, termasuk bila mesin gagal."
		If(Number Of Players(Team 1) >= Number Of Slots(Team 1));
			If(Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Team 1), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)) > 0);
				Global.TimBotBuatanAktif = Team 1;
				Global.WaktuCobaBotBuatanTim1 = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
				Call Subroutine(LepasBotBuatanTim);
			End;
		Else;
			If(And(Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Skirmish), And(Number Of Players(Team 1) < Number Of Slots(Team 1) - 1, And(Count Of(Spawn Points(Team 1)) > 0, And(Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Team 1), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)) == 0, Total Time Elapsed >= Global.WaktuCobaBotBuatanTim1)))));
				Global.TimBotBuatanAktif = Team 1;
				Global.WaktuCobaBotBuatanTim1 = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
				Call Subroutine(BuatBotBuatanTim);
			End;
		End;
		If(Number Of Players(Team 2) >= Number Of Slots(Team 2));
			If(Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Team 2), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)) > 0);
				Global.TimBotBuatanAktif = Team 2;
				Global.WaktuCobaBotBuatanTim2 = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
				Call Subroutine(LepasBotBuatanTim);
			End;
		Else;
			If(And(Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Skirmish), And(Number Of Players(Team 2) < Number Of Slots(Team 2) - 1, And(Count Of(Spawn Points(Team 2)) > 0, And(Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Team 2), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)) == 0, Total Time Elapsed >= Global.WaktuCobaBotBuatanTim2)))));
				Global.TimBotBuatanAktif = Team 2;
				Global.WaktuCobaBotBuatanTim2 = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
				Call Subroutine(BuatBotBuatanTim);
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("03f - Bot: Teleportasi dari ruang muncul ke objektif")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True;
		Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Skirmish);
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Is In Spawn Room(Event Player) == True;
		Count Of(Spawn Points(Team Of(Event Player))) > 0;
		Or(Event Player.WaktuTeleportasiBotBuatan == 0, Total Time Elapsed >= Event Player.WaktuTeleportasiBotBuatan) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.WaktuTeleportasiBotBuatan == 0);
			Event Player.WaktuTeleportasiBotBuatan = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
			Event Player.KursorTeleportasiBotBuatan = 0;
			Abort;
		End;
		Event Player.WaktuTeleportasiBotBuatan = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
		Event Player.PosisiMati = Objective Position(Objective Index);
		Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiMati, Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
			"Coba arah mendatar berbeda setiap detik, lalu ulangi pada jarak yang lebih jauh."
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.PosisiMati + Direction From Angles(Horizontal Angle From Direction(Direction Towards(Event Player.PosisiMati, Position Of(First Of(Spawn Points(Team Of(Event Player)))))) + (Event Player.KursorTeleportasiBotBuatan % 8) * 45, 0) * (Event Player.KursorTeleportasiBotBuatan < 8 ? 8 : 12));
			Event Player.PosisiTujuanTeleportasi = Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman;
			Event Player.KursorTeleportasiBotBuatan = (Event Player.KursorTeleportasiBotBuatan + 1) % 16;
			Call Subroutine(CariPosisiTeleportasiAman);
			If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Event Player.PosisiMati) >= 6);
				If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Event Player.PosisiMati) <= 16);
					If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 5, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman - Vector(0, 20, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman) <= 6);
						If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
							Teleport(Event Player, Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman);
						End;
					End;
				End;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("03g - Bot: Hadap dan dekati manusia musuh hidup terdekat")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan != Null;
		Entity Exists(Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan) == True;
		Player Variable(Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan, Manusia) == True;
		Player Variable(Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan, IzinkanBotBuatanMengikuti) == True;
		Has Spawned(Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan) == True;
		Team Of(Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan) == Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Event Player));
	}

	actions
	{
		Start Facing(Event Player, Direction Towards(Eye Position(Event Player), Eye Position(Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan)), 1000, To World, Direction and Turn Rate);
		Start Throttle In Direction(Event Player, Forward, Or(Is In Spawn Room(Event Player), Distance Between(Event Player, Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan) <= 4) ? 0 : 1, To Player, Replace Existing Throttle, Direction and Magnitude);
	}
}

rule("03h - Bot: Hentikan gerak saat tidak ada manusia musuh hidup")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True;
		Or(Or(Or(Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan == Null, Entity Exists(Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan) == False), Or(Player Variable(Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan, Manusia) == False, Player Variable(Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan, IzinkanBotBuatanMengikuti) == False)), Or(Or(Has Spawned(Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan) == False, Is Alive(Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan) == False), Team Of(Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan) != Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Event Player)))) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Stop Facing(Event Player);
		Stop Throttle In Direction(Event Player);
	}
}

rule("03i - Bot: Hentikan gerak saat bot mati")
{
	event
	{
		Player Died;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == False;
	}

	actions
	{
		Stop Facing(Event Player);
		Stop Throttle In Direction(Event Player);
		Event Player.WaktuTeleportasiBotBuatan = 0;
		Event Player.KursorTeleportasiBotBuatan = 0;
		Event Player.TargetIkutiBotBuatan = Null;
	}
}

rule("04 - Pemain Keluar: Bersihkan hanya saat benar-benar keluar")
{
	event
	{
		Player Left Match;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Or(Event Player.BotOtomatis == True, Or(Event Player.Manusia == True, Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player))) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.BotOtomatis == True);
			If(Event Player.TeksVisiNasib != Null);
				If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player) >= 0);
					If(Global.TeksVisiSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player)] == Event Player.TeksVisiNasib);
						Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.TeksVisiNasib);
						Global.TeksVisiSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player)] = 0;
					End;
				End;
			End;
			Event Player.TeksVisiNasib = Null;
			Global.PemainTeksPembersihan = Event Player;
			Call Subroutine(BersihkanTeksYatim);
			Abort;
		End;
		Wait(0.500, Ignore Condition);
		Abort If(Entity Exists(Event Player) == True);
		Call Subroutine(BersihkanPemain);
		If(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Event Player);
			Global.PemainSiklusGlobal = Null;
			Global.WaktuSiklusGlobal = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
		End;
	}
}

rule("04g - Utama global: Penjadwal pusat 20 Hz")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Langkah 0,05 detik adalah satu-satunya sumber pembaruan dan satu-satunya pengulangan di seluruh skrip."
		Global.LangkahPenjadwal = (Global.LangkahPenjadwal + 1) % 200;
		If(Global.LangkahPenjadwal % 2 == 0);
			Global.RGB = Custom Color(
				80 + (Global.RGBFase < 255 ? 255 : Global.RGBFase < 510 ? 510 - Global.RGBFase : Global.RGBFase < 1020 ? 0 : Global.RGBFase < 1275 ? Global.RGBFase - 1020 : 255) * 0.686,
				80 + (Global.RGBFase < 255 ? Global.RGBFase : Global.RGBFase < 765 ? 255 : Global.RGBFase < 1020 ? 1020 - Global.RGBFase : 0) * 0.686,
				80 + (Global.RGBFase < 510 ? 0 : Global.RGBFase < 765 ? Global.RGBFase - 510 : Global.RGBFase < 1275 ? 255 : 1530 - Global.RGBFase) * 0.686,
				255);
			Global.RGBFase = (Global.RGBFase + 3) % 1530;
		End;
		If(And(Global.LangkahPenjadwal % 20 == 0, Global.MulaiUlangSudahDiminta == False));
			Global.SisaWaktuServer = Max(0, Round To Integer(Global.WaktuAkhirServer - Total Time Elapsed, Up));
			Global.TeksWaktuServer = Global.SisaWaktuServer % 60 < 10 ? Custom String("{0}:0{1}", Round To Integer(Global.SisaWaktuServer / 60, Down),
				Global.SisaWaktuServer % 60) : Custom String("{0}:{1}", Round To Integer(Global.SisaWaktuServer / 60, Down), Global.SisaWaktuServer % 60);
			If(And(Is Game In Progress == True, Global.SisaWaktuServer > 0));
				"Satu kali per detik, tahan penyelesaian mode bawaan dan sinkronkan penghitung waktu bawaan di atas nol sampai waktu server habis."
				Disable Built-In Game Mode Completion;
				Set Match Time(Max(1, Global.SisaWaktuServer));
			End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal != Null, Or(Entity Exists(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal) == False, Has Spawned(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal) == False)));
			Global.PemainSiklusGlobal = Null;
			Global.WaktuSiklusGlobal = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
		End;
		"Salinan daftar pemain mencegah koleksi aktif berubah selama putaran penjadwal."
		Global.SalinanDaftarPemain = All Players(All Teams);
		If(Is True For Any(Global.SalinanDaftarPemain, Player Variable(Current Array Element, PrivasiNasibAktif) == True));
			Global.PenontonVisiNasib = Filtered Array(Global.SalinanDaftarPemain, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, Manusia) == True, Player Variable(Current Array Element, PrivasiNasibAktif) == True)));
		Else;
			If(Count Of(Global.PenontonVisiNasib) > 0);
				Global.PenontonVisiNasib = Empty Array;
			End;
		End;
		For Global Variable(IndeksPemainGlobal, 0, Count Of(Global.SalinanDaftarPemain), 1);
			Global.PemainAktif = Global.SalinanDaftarPemain[Global.IndeksPemainGlobal];
			"Entitas belum terklasifikasi tetap masuk penyiapan; bot terklasifikasi hanya masuk pemeliharaan bot."
			If(And(Is Dummy Bot(Global.PemainAktif) == False, Global.PemainAktif.BotOtomatis == False));
				Call Subroutine(ProsesCepatPemain);
				If(Array Contains(Global.PemainPukulanSuper, Global.PemainAktif));
					Call Subroutine(ProsesPukulanSuper);
				End;
				If(Global.PemainAktif.ModeLompatGanda == True);
					Call Subroutine(ProsesLompatGanda);
				End;
				"Tenggat ikon tetap diproses saat efek selesai atau pemain sedang berpindah tim."
				If(Or(Global.PemainAktif.KartuNasibAktif == True, Or(Global.PemainAktif.PutaranKartuNasib > 0, Or(Global.PemainAktif.EfekNasib != 0, Global.PemainAktif.WaktuIkonNasibBerakhir > 0))));
					Call Subroutine(ProsesNasibPemain);
				End;
				If(And(Global.PemainAktif.Manusia == True, Global.PemainAktif.ModeTerbangAktif == True));
					Call Subroutine(ProsesTerbangPemain);
				End;
				"Pemulihan kamera dan inspeksi tetap berjalan selama karantina perpindahan tim."
				If(Global.LangkahPenjadwal % 2 == (Global.PemainAktif.Manusia == True ? Global.PemainAktif.UrutanHUD : Slot Of(Global.PemainAktif)) % 2);
					Call Subroutine(ProsesSiklusPemain);
				End;
				If(Global.LangkahPenjadwal % 20 == (Global.PemainAktif.Manusia == True ? Global.PemainAktif.UrutanHUD : Slot Of(Global.PemainAktif)) % 20);
					"Pilihan otomatis sekali saja; pemaksaan langsung dilepas agar pahlawan tetap bebas diganti."
					If(Global.PemainAktif.PilihanPahlawanSelesai == False);
						If(Has Spawned(Global.PemainAktif) == True);
							Global.PemainAktif.PilihanPahlawanSelesai = True;
							Global.PemainAktif.WaktuPilihPahlawan = 0;
						Else;
							If(Or(Team Of(Global.PemainAktif) == Team 1, Team Of(Global.PemainAktif) == Team 2));
								If(And(Global.PemainAktif.WaktuPilihPahlawan > 0, Total Time Elapsed >= Global.PemainAktif.WaktuPilihPahlawan));
									Global.PemainAktif.PilihanPahlawanSelesai = True;
									Global.PemainAktif.WaktuPilihPahlawan = 0;
									Start Forcing Player To Be Hero(Global.PemainAktif, Hero(Shion));
									Stop Forcing Player To Be Hero(Global.PemainAktif);
								End;
							Else;
								Global.PemainAktif.WaktuPilihPahlawan = 0;
							End;
						End;
					End;
					If(And(Global.PemainAktif.Manusia == True, Or(Global.PemainAktif.IzinkanBotBuatanMengikuti == True, And(Global.PemainAktif.MenuTerbuka == True, Or(Global.PemainAktif.HalamanMenu == 1, Global.PemainAktif.HalamanMenu == 4)))));
						Call Subroutine(ProsesSimpananPemain);
					End;
				End;
			Else;
				If(Global.LangkahPenjadwal % 2 == Slot Of(Global.PemainAktif) % 2);
					Call Subroutine(ProsesBotPemain);
				End;
			End;
		End;
		Global.PemainAktif = Null;
		Global.SalinanDaftarPemain = Empty Array;
		If(Global.LangkahPenjadwal % 20 == 0);
			Call Subroutine(RawatBotBuatan);
			Call Subroutine(PerbaruiPilarSosial);
			Global.PemainTeksPembersihan = Null;
			Call Subroutine(BersihkanTeksYatim);
		End;
		If(Global.PilihanPerluDihitung == True);
			Global.PilihanPerluDihitung = False;
			Call Subroutine(HitungPilihan);
		End;
		Wait(0.050, Ignore Condition);
		Loop If Condition Is True;
	}
}

rule("05 - Menu: Tahan serangan jarak dekat 0,5 detik untuk buka atau tutup")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.SeranganDekatDipakai == False;
		Event Player.TeleportasiJongkokAktif == False;
		Event Player.KartuNasibAktif == False;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Melee)) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Wait(0.500, Abort When False);
		Event Player.SeranganDekatDipakai = True;
		If(Event Player.MenuTerbuka == True);
			Call Subroutine(TutupMenu);
		Else;
			Event Player.MenuTerbuka = True;
			Event Player.HalamanMenu = -1;
			Call Subroutine(GambarMenu);
		End;
	}
}

rule("05b - Menu: Lepaskan serangan jarak dekat sebelum pakai lagi")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.SeranganDekatDipakai == True;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Melee)) == False;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.MenuTerbuka == False);
			Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Melee));
		End;
		Event Player.SeranganDekatDipakai = False;
	}
}

rule("05c - Menu: Pengatur masukan dengan prioritas tetap")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka == True;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == True;
		Event Player.PerintahMenu == 0;
		Event Player.InteraksiKameraDipakai == False;
		Event Player.KartuNasibAktif == False;
		Or(Or(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Interact)), And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Reload)), Event Player.HalamanMenu != -1)), Or(Or(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire)), Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire))), And(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 2, Or(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 1)), Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 2)))))) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Interact)));
			Event Player.InteraksiKameraDipakai = True;
			Event Player.PerintahMenu = 1;
		Else If(And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Reload)), Event Player.HalamanMenu != -1));
			Event Player.PerintahMenu = 2;
		Else If(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire)));
			Event Player.PerintahMenu = 3;
		Else If(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire)));
			Event Player.PerintahMenu = 4;
		Else If(And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 1)), Event Player.HalamanMenu == 2));
			Event Player.PerintahMenu = 5;
		Else If(And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 2)), Event Player.HalamanMenu == 2));
			Event Player.PerintahMenu = 6;
		End;
	}
}

rule("05d - Menu: Lepaskan pengatur setelah semua masukan dilepas")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.PerintahMenu != 0;
		And(And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Interact)) == False, Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Reload)) == False), And(And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire)) == False, Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire)) == False), And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 1)) == False, Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 2)) == False))) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Aktifkan kembali pengatur segera setelah semua tombol dilepas; pengunci tetap mencegah pengulangan saat tombol ditahan."
		Event Player.PerintahMenu = 0;
	}
}

rule("05e - Menu: Jongkok mengunci masukan pahlawan hanya saat navigasi")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka == True;
		Event Player.MasukanMenuDikunci == False;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.MasukanMenuDikunci = True;
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Interact));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Reload));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 1));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 2));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Ultimate));
	}
}

rule("05f - Menu: Lepaskan Jongkok dan segera pulihkan masukan pahlawan")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.PindahTimDiproses == False;
		Event Player.SiklusPemainAktif == False;
		Event Player.MasukanMenuDikunci == True;
		Or(Event Player.MenuTerbuka == False, Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == False) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Interact));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Reload));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 1));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 2));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ultimate));
		Event Player.MasukanMenuDikunci = False;
		Event Player.PerintahMenu = 0;
	}
}

rule("06 - Menu: Navigasi berikutnya dan sebelumnya")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka == True;
		Or(Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3, Event Player.PerintahMenu == 4) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == -1);
			Event Player.KursorUtama = (Event Player.KursorUtama + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : 15)) % 16;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 0);
			Event Player.KursorWarna = (Event Player.KursorWarna + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Global.DaftarWarna) - 1)) % Count Of(Global.DaftarWarna);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 1);
			Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetKamera);
			Event Player.KursorKamera = (Event Player.KursorKamera + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera) + 1)) % (Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera) + 2);
		Else If(And(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 2, Event Player.MusikKhusus == Null));
			Event Player.KursorGenre = (Event Player.KursorGenre + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Global.DaftarGenre) - 1)) % Count Of(Global.DaftarGenre);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 3);
			Event Player.KursorBahasa = (Event Player.KursorBahasa + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : 2)) % 3;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 4);
			Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetBalasDendam);
			If(Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam) > 0);
				Event Player.KursorBalasDendam = (Event Player.KursorBalasDendam + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam) - 1)) % Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam);
			End;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 5);
			Event Player.KursorKebal = (Event Player.KursorKebal + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : 2)) % 3;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 6);
			Event Player.KursorSuara = (Event Player.KursorSuara + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : 4)) % 5;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 7);
			Event Player.KursorIkon = (Event Player.KursorIkon + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Global.DaftarIkon) - 1)) % Count Of(Global.DaftarIkon);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 11);
			If(Count Of(Global.PemainManusia) > 0);
				Event Player.KursorPilihan = (Event Player.KursorPilihan + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Global.PemainManusia) - 1)) % Count Of(Global.PemainManusia);
			End;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 13);
			Event Player.KursorHantuTerbang = (Event Player.KursorHantuTerbang + 1) % 2;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 14);
			Event Player.KursorLompatGanda = (Event Player.KursorLompatGanda + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : 10)) % 11;
		End;
		Call Subroutine(TransisiWarnaMenu);
	}
}

rule("08 - Menu musik: Lompat maju atau mundur sepuluh genre")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka == True;
		Event Player.HalamanMenu == 2;
		Event Player.MusikKhusus == Null;
		Or(Event Player.PerintahMenu == 5, Event Player.PerintahMenu == 6) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.KursorGenre = (Event Player.KursorGenre + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 5 ? 10 : Count Of(Global.DaftarGenre) - 10)) % Count Of(Global.DaftarGenre);
	}
}

rule("10 - Menu: Terapkan halaman aktif")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka == True;
		Event Player.PerintahMenu == 1;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == -1);
			"Empat sakelar utama diterapkan langsung; halaman dan kursor tetap pada menu utama."
			If(Event Player.KursorUtama == 8);
				Call Subroutine(TerapkanTeleportasiJongkok);
			Else If(Event Player.KursorUtama == 9);
				Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanPrivasiInspeksi);
			Else If(Event Player.KursorUtama == 12);
				Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanIkutiBotBuatan);
			Else If(Event Player.KursorUtama == 15);
				Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanPukulanSuper);
			Else;
				Event Player.HalamanMenu = Event Player.KursorUtama;
				If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 1);
					Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetKamera);
				Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 4);
					Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetBalasDendam);
				Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 5);
					Event Player.KursorKebal = Event Player.ModeKebal;
				Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 11);
					Event Player.KursorPilihan = And(Event Player.PemainDipilih != Null, Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player.PemainDipilih)) ? Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player.PemainDipilih) : Min(Event Player.KursorPilihan, Max(0, Count Of(Global.PemainManusia) - 1));
				Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 13);
					Event Player.KursorHantuTerbang %= 2;
				Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 14);
					Event Player.KursorLompatGanda = Event Player.ModeLompatGanda ? Event Player.TingkatLompatGanda : 0;
				End;
				Call Subroutine(GambarMenu);
			End;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 0);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanWarna);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 1);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanKamera);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 2);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanMusik);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 3);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanBahasa);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 4);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanBalasDendam);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 5);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanKebal);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 6);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanSuara);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 7);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanIkon);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 10);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanNasib);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 11);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanPilihan);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 13);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanHantuTerbang);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 14);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanLompatGanda);
		End;
	}
}

rule("99a - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman musik")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanMusik;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Event Player.MusikKhusus != Null);
		If(Event Player.IndeksGenre != Event Player.KursorGenre);
			Event Player.IndeksGenre = Event Player.KursorGenre;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99b - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman kamera")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanKamera;
	}

	actions
	{
		Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetKamera);
		Event Player.KursorKamera %= Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera) + 2;
		If(Event Player.KursorKamera == 0);
			If(Event Player.ModeKamera != 0);
				Stop Camera(Event Player);
				Event Player.ModeKamera = 0;
				Event Player.TargetKamera = Null;
			End;
		Else If(Event Player.KursorKamera == 1);
			If(Or(Event Player.ModeKamera != 1, Event Player.TargetKamera != Event Player));
				Event Player.TargetKamera = Event Player;
				Event Player.ModeKamera = 1;
				Call Subroutine(MulaiKamera);
			End;
		Else;
			If(Event Player.KursorKamera - 2 < Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera));
				Event Player.CalonTargetKamera = Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera[Event Player.KursorKamera - 2];
			Else;
				Event Player.CalonTargetKamera = Null;
			End;
			If(And(Event Player.CalonTargetKamera != Null, Entity Exists(Event Player.CalonTargetKamera)));
				If(Or(Event Player.ModeKamera != 2, Event Player.TargetKamera != Event Player.CalonTargetKamera));
					Event Player.TargetKamera = Event Player.CalonTargetKamera;
					Event Player.ModeKamera = 2;
					Call Subroutine(MulaiKamera);
				End;
			Else;
				Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Camera target unavailable. Poof!") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Target kamera tak tersedia. Coba yang lain!") : Custom String("เป้าหมายกล้องหายไปแล้ว พักกล้องก่อน!"));
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99c - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman warna")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanWarna;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.IndeksWarna != Event Player.KursorWarna);
			Event Player.IndeksWarna = Event Player.KursorWarna;
			Event Player.WarnaNama = Global.DaftarWarna[Event Player.IndeksWarna];
			If(Global.PemimpinPilihan == Event Player);
				Global.WarnaPemimpinPilihan = Event Player.WarnaNama;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

}

rule("99e - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman balas dendam")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanBalasDendam;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(And(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci != Null, And(Entity Exists(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci), Player Variable(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, PenagihBalasDendam) == Event Player)));
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Revenge pending. Debt drops when the target dies.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Balas dendam diproses. Utang berkurang saat target mati.") : Custom String("ล้างแค้นอยู่ รอเป้าหมายตายจริงก่อนตัดหนี้"));
		Else;
			Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci = Null;
			Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetBalasDendam);
			If(Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam) == 0);
				Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("No revenge targets. Peace wins!") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Tak ada target balas dendam. Damai dulu!") : Custom String("ไม่มีเป้าหมายล้างแค้น พักรบก่อน!"));
			Else;
				Event Player.KursorBalasDendam %= Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam);
				Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci = Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam[Event Player.KursorBalasDendam];
				Event Player.IndeksBalasDendam = Index Of Array Value(Event Player.PembunuhBalasDendam, Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci);
				If(Event Player.IndeksBalasDendam < 0);
					Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("No revenge debt on that player.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Pemain itu tak punya utang. Damai, ya!") : Custom String("คนนี้ไม่มีหนี้แค้น พักรบก่อน!"));
					Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci = Null;
				Else If(Event Player.JumlahBalasDendam[Event Player.IndeksBalasDendam] <= 0);
					Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Revenge debt cleared. Case closed!") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Utang balas dendam lunas. Beres!") : Custom String("หนี้แค้นหมดแล้ว ปิดคดี!"));
					Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci = Null;
				Else If(Or(Entity Exists(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci) == False, Is Alive(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci) == False));
					Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Revenge target already down.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Target sudah tumbang. Sabar dulu!") : Custom String("เป้าหมายล้มแล้ว ล้างแค้นพักก่อน!"));
					Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci = Null;
				Else If(Player Variable(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, KematianBalasDendam) == True);
					Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Revenge pending on that target.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Balas dendam ke target itu masih diproses.") : Custom String("เป้าหมายกำลังถูกล้างแค้นอยู่"));
					Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci = Null;
				Else If(Player Variable(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, KartuNasibAktif) == True);
					Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Target busy with Try Your Luck.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Target lagi Coba Nasib. Tunggu dulu!") : Custom String("เป้าหมายเสี่ยงโชคอยู่ รอจบก่อน"));
					Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci = Null;
				Else;
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, KematianBalasDendam, True);
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, PenagihBalasDendam, Event Player);
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, WaktuPaksaBerikut, Total Time Elapsed);
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, WaktuPaksaBerakhir, Total Time Elapsed + 5);
					Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Revenge on {0}. Confirming the kill.", Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci) : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Balas dendam ke {0}. Tunggu target mati.", Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci) : Custom String("เริ่มล้างแค้น {0} รอให้ตายจริง", Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci));
				End;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99f - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman kebal")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanKebal;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.ModeKebal != Event Player.KursorKebal);
			If(And(Event Player.KursorKebal == 1, Is In Spawn Room(Event Player) == True));
				Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("1 HP is disabled in spawn. FULL HP works.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Kebal 1 HP tak bisa di ruang muncul. HP PENUH bisa.") : Custom String("ห้องเกิด: 1 HP (ฮีลได้) ใช้ไม่ได้ แต่ HP เต็ม ใช้ได้"));
			Else;
				Event Player.ModeKebal = Event Player.KursorKebal;
				Event Player.KebalAktif = Event Player.ModeKebal != 0;
				If(Event Player.ModeKebal == 0);
					Clear Status(Event Player, Unkillable);
					Set Damage Received(Event Player, 100);
					Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 100);
					Enable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
					If(Is Alive(Event Player) == True);
						Set Player Health(Event Player, Max Health(Event Player));
					End;
					If(Event Player.IkonKebal != Null);
						Destroy Icon(Event Player.IkonKebal);
						Event Player.IkonKebal = Null;
						If(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player));
							Global.IkonKebalPemain[Global.SlotHUDPemain[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player)]] = 0;
						End;
					End;
				Else;
					Clear Status(Event Player, Unkillable);
					Set Status(Event Player, Null, Unkillable, 9999);
					If(Event Player.ModeKebal == 1);
						Set Damage Received(Event Player, 100);
						Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 100);
						Enable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
						If(Is Alive(Event Player) == True);
							Set Player Health(Event Player, 1);
						End;
					Else;
						Set Damage Received(Event Player, 0);
						Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 0);
						Disable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
						If(Is Alive(Event Player) == True);
							Set Player Health(Event Player, Max Health(Event Player));
						End;
					End;
					If(Event Player.IkonKebal != Null);
						Destroy Icon(Event Player.IkonKebal);
						Event Player.IkonKebal = Null;
						If(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player));
							Global.IkonKebalPemain[Global.SlotHUDPemain[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player)]] = 0;
						End;
					End;
					If(Event Player.ModeKebal == 1);
						Create Icon(All Players(All Teams), Event Player, Warning, Visible To and Position, Custom Color(255, 80, 80, 255), True);
					Else;
						Create Icon(All Players(All Teams), Event Player, Halo, Visible To and Position, Global.RGB, True);
					End;
					Event Player.IkonKebal = Last Created Entity;
					If(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player));
						Global.IkonKebalPemain[Global.SlotHUDPemain[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player)]] = Event Player.IkonKebal;
					End;
				End;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99g - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman suara pahlawan")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanSuara;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.IndeksSuara != Event Player.KursorSuara);
			Event Player.IndeksSuara = Event Player.KursorSuara;
			If(Event Player.IndeksSuara == 0);
				Stop Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player);
			Else If(Event Player.IndeksSuara == 1);
				Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player, 0.500, False);
			Else If(Event Player.IndeksSuara == 2);
				Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player, 0.750, False);
			Else If(Event Player.IndeksSuara == 3);
				Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player, 1.250, False);
			Else;
				Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player, 1.500, False);
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99k - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman coba nasib")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanNasib;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.KartuNasibAktif == True);
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Try Your Luck already active.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Coba Nasib masih aktif. Sabar, ya!") : Custom String("เสี่ยงโชคอยู่ รอจบก่อน"));
		Else If(Event Player.KematianBalasDendam == True);
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Under Revenge. Try Your Luck is locked.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Tunggu balas dendam selesai, baru Coba Nasib.") : Custom String("กำลังโดนล้างแค้น รอจบก่อนเสี่ยงโชค"));
		Else;
			Event Player.KartuNasibAktif = True;
			Event Player.EfekNasib = Random Integer(1, 6);
			Event Player.PutaranKartuNasib = Random Integer(20, 24);
			Event Player.JedaKartuNasib = 0.080;
			Event Player.EfekNasibBerakhir = 0;
			Event Player.WaktuBakarNasibBerikut = 0;
			Event Player.WaktuPutaranNasibBerikut = Total Time Elapsed;
			Event Player.WaktuIkonNasibBerakhir = 0;
			Event Player.PrivasiNasibAktif = False;
			Event Player.MenuNasibHarusDibuka = False;
			If(Event Player.IkonKartuNasib != Null);
				Destroy Icon(Event Player.IkonKartuNasib);
			End;
			Event Player.IkonKartuNasib = Null;
			If(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player));
				Global.IkonKartuNasibPemain[Global.SlotHUDPemain[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player)]] = 0;
			End;
			"Coba Nasib mempertahankan pilihan Kebal; hanya kematian penuh Tengkorak yang menangguhkan perlindungan sampai bangkit kembali."
		End;
	}
}

rule("99l - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman pilihan pemain")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanPilihan;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Count Of(Global.PemainManusia) > 0);
			Event Player.KursorPilihan %= Count Of(Global.PemainManusia);
			If(Event Player.PemainDipilih != Global.PemainManusia[Event Player.KursorPilihan]);
				"Simpan pilihan pemilik; penjadwal menghitung seluruh perubahan bersama-sama pada langkah berikutnya."
				Event Player.PemainDipilih = Global.PemainManusia[Event Player.KursorPilihan];
				Global.PilihanPerluDihitung = True;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99m - Subrutin: Terapkan izin bot buatan mengikuti")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanIkutiBotBuatan;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Aktifkan izin hanya jika bot buatan musuh benar-benar ada; mematikan izin selalu boleh."
		Abort If(And(Event Player.IzinkanBotBuatanMengikuti == False, Is True For Any(All Players(Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Event Player))), And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)) == False));
		Event Player.IzinkanBotBuatanMengikuti = Event Player.IzinkanBotBuatanMengikuti == False;
	}
}

rule("99n - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman Mode Hantu / Terbang")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanHantuTerbang;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.KursorHantuTerbang == 0);
			Event Player.ModeHantuAktif = Event Player.ModeHantuAktif == False;
		Else;
			Event Player.ModeTerbangAktif = Event Player.ModeTerbangAktif == False;
		End;
		Event Player.FisikaHantuTerbangDiterapkan = False;
		Call Subroutine(TerapkanFisikaHantuTerbang);
	}
}

rule("99o - Subrutin: Terapkan fisika Mode Hantu / Terbang")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanFisikaHantuTerbang;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.ModeHantuAktif == True);
			Disable Movement Collision With Environment(Event Player, False);
		Else;
			Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Event Player);
		End;
		Event Player.WaktuMulaiTerbangMaju = -1;
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Event Player);
		If(Event Player.ModeTerbangAktif == True);
			If(Or(Event Player.EfekNasib != 2, Event Player.EfekNasibBerakhir <= Total Time Elapsed));
				Set Move Speed(Event Player, 0);
			End;
			Set Gravity(Event Player, 0);
		Else;
			If(Or(Event Player.EfekNasib != 2, Event Player.EfekNasibBerakhir <= Total Time Elapsed));
				Set Move Speed(Event Player, 100);
				If(Magnitude Of(Velocity Of(Event Player)) > 0.010);
					Apply Impulse(Event Player, Velocity Of(Event Player) * -1, Magnitude Of(Velocity Of(Event Player)), To World, Incorporate Contrary Motion);
				End;
			End;
			Set Gravity(Event Player, 100);
		End;
		Event Player.FisikaHantuTerbangDiterapkan = True;
	}
}

rule("11 - Menu: Isi ulang kembali dari submenu ke menu utama")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka == True;
		Event Player.HalamanMenu != -1;
		Event Player.PerintahMenu == 2;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.HalamanMenu = -1;
		Call Subroutine(GambarMenu);
	}
}

rule("12c - Kamera: Tahan Interaksi setengah detik untuk beralih")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.InteraksiKameraDipakai == False;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == False;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Interact)) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Wait(0.500, Abort When False);
		Event Player.InteraksiKameraDipakai = True;
		If(Event Player.ModeKamera == 0);
			Event Player.TargetKamera = Event Player;
			Event Player.ModeKamera = 1;
			Call Subroutine(MulaiKamera);
		Else;
			Stop Camera(Event Player);
			Event Player.ModeKamera = 0;
			Event Player.TargetKamera = Null;
		End;
	}
}

rule("12e - Bangkit Lompat: Simpan posisi kematian")
{
	event
	{
		Player Died;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == False;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.PosisiMati = Position Of(Event Player);
		Stop Accelerating(Event Player);
		Set Move Speed(Event Player, 100);
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Event Player);
		Set Gravity(Event Player, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Event Player);
		Event Player.FisikaHantuTerbangDiterapkan = False;
		Event Player.WaktuMulaiTerbangMaju = -1;
		"Pertahankan kunci Lompat saat mati lagi; hanya pelepasan tombol yang membuka percobaan baru."
		Event Player.PerintahMenu = 0;
		Event Player.PerintahTeleportasi = 0;
		Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Press {0}: revive here. Void death? Back to walkable ground.", Input Binding String(Button(Jump))) : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Tekan {0}: bangkit di sini. Jatuh ke jurang? Kembali ke tanah aman.", Input Binding String(Button(Jump))) : Custom String("กด {0}: ฟื้นตรงนี้ | ตกเหว: ฟื้นบนพื้นที่เดินได้", Input Binding String(Button(Jump))));
	}
}

rule("12f - Bangkit Lompat: Bangkit di posisi aman yang bisa dilalui")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.BangkitLompatDipakai == False;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Jump)) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.BangkitLompatDipakai = True;
		"Cari tanah yang bisa dilalui sekali; permukaan jurang dapat mengenai raycast meskipun tidak aman."
		Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Nearest Walkable Position(Position Of(Event Player));
		Event Player.BangkitPerluTeleportasi = Or(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiMati + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiMati - Vector(0, 3, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiMati) > 2.500, Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Event Player.PosisiMati) > 0.500);
		"Pindahkan sebelum bangkit, lalu pastikan tujuan yang sama setelah bangkit tanpa menunggu satu bingkai."
		If(Event Player.BangkitPerluTeleportasi == True);
			Teleport(Event Player, Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 0.500, 0));
		End;
		Resurrect(Event Player);
		If(Event Player.BangkitPerluTeleportasi == True);
			Teleport(Event Player, Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 0.500, 0));
		End;
		Event Player.BangkitPerluTeleportasi = False;
		If(Is Alive(Event Player) == True);
			Event Player.FisikaHantuTerbangDiterapkan = False;
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanFisikaHantuTerbang);
		End;
	}
}

rule("12g - Bangkit Lompat: Lepaskan Lompat sebelum mencoba lagi")

rule("13 - Intip Pahlawan: Nama mengikuti target bidikan")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka == False;
		Event Player.PrivasiNasibAktif == False;
		Event Player.TeleportasiJongkokAktif == False;
		Event Player.TeleportasiJongkokDiaktifkan == False;
		Event Player.ModeKamera != 2;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == True;
		Or(Event Player.TargetInspeksi != Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi, Or(And(Event Player.TeksDunia != Null, Or(Entity Exists(Event Player.TargetInspeksi) == False, Or(Has Spawned(Event Player.TargetInspeksi) == False, Or(Is Alive(Event Player.TargetInspeksi) == False, And(And(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player.TargetInspeksi) == False, Player Variable(Event Player.TargetInspeksi, BotOtomatis) == False), Or(Player Variable(Event Player.TargetInspeksi, Manusia) == False, Or(Player Variable(Event Player.TargetInspeksi, PrivasiInspeksiAktif) == True, Player Variable(Event Player.TargetInspeksi, PembaruanDaftarTertunda) == True))))))), And(Event Player.TeksDunia == Null, And(Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi != Null, Total Time Elapsed >= Event Player.WaktuTeksTargetBerikut)))) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.InspeksiAktif == False);
			Event Player.InspeksiAktif = True;
			Disable Nameplates(All Players(All Teams), Event Player);
			Event Player.PelatNamaDinonaktifkan = True;
		End;
		If(Event Player.TeksDunia != Null);
			Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.TeksDunia);
		End;
		If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) >= 0);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.TeksDuniaPemain));
				Global.TeksDuniaPemain[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player)] = 0;
			End;
		End;
		Event Player.TeksDunia = Null;
		Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetInspeksi);
		Abort If(Event Player.TargetInspeksi == Null);
		Abort If(Total Time Elapsed < Event Player.WaktuTeksTargetBerikut);
		"Batasi pembuatan nama gabungan menjadi empat kali per detik; nama lama dihapus sebelum batas waktu diperiksa."
		Event Player.WaktuTeksTargetBerikut = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
		Create In-World Text(Event Player, Custom String("{0} {1} | {2}", Hero Icon String(Is Duplicating(Evaluate Once(Event Player.TargetInspeksi)) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Evaluate Once(Event Player.TargetInspeksi)) : Hero Of(Evaluate Once(Event Player.TargetInspeksi))), Evaluate Once(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player.TargetInspeksi) == True ? Player Variable(Event Player.TargetInspeksi, NamaTampilan) : Custom String("{0}", Is Duplicating(Event Player.TargetInspeksi) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Event Player.TargetInspeksi) : Hero Of(Event Player.TargetInspeksi))), Round To Integer(Health(Evaluate Once(Event Player.TargetInspeksi)), Down)), Update Every Frame(Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Event Player.TargetInspeksi)) + Vector(0, 0.450, 0)), 1.100, Do Not Clip, Visible To Position String and Color, Evaluate Once(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player.TargetInspeksi) == True ? Player Variable(Event Player.TargetInspeksi, WarnaNama) : Custom Color(236, 153, 0, 255)), Visible Never);
		Event Player.TeksDunia = Last Text ID;
		If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) >= 0);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.TeksDuniaPemain));
				Global.TeksDuniaPemain[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player)] = Event Player.TeksDunia;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("16a - Anran: Kemampuan pamungkas menjadi 100 persen setiap kali mati")

}

rule("17 - Balas Dendam: Catat hanya pembunuh langsung")
{
	event
	{
		Player Died;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.KematianBalasDendam == True);
			If(Is Alive(Event Player) == False);
				If(And(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam != Null, And(Entity Exists(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam), And(Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, Manusia) == True, Attacker == Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam))));
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBalasDendam, Index Of Array Value(Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, PembunuhBalasDendam), Event Player));
					If(And(Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBalasDendam) >= 0, Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, JumlahBalasDendam)[Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBalasDendam)] > 0));
						Modify Player Variable At Index(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, JumlahBalasDendam, Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBalasDendam), Subtract, 1);
						Small Message(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBahasa) == 0 ? Custom String("Revenge on {0}: paid! Still owed: {1}.", Event Player, Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, JumlahBalasDendam)[Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBalasDendam)]) : Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBahasa) == 1 ? Custom String("Balas dendam ke {0} beres! Sisa: {1}.", Event Player, Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, JumlahBalasDendam)[Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBalasDendam)]) : Custom String("ล้างแค้น {0} สำเร็จ! หนี้เหลือ: {1}", Event Player, Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, JumlahBalasDendam)[Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBalasDendam)]));
					End;
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, Null);
					Event Player.KematianBalasDendam = False;
					Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam = Null;
					Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerikut = 0;
					Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerakhir = 0;
					Abort;
				End;
				If(And(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam != Null, Entity Exists(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam)));
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, Null);
				End;
				Event Player.KematianBalasDendam = False;
				Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam = Null;
				Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerikut = 0;
				Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerakhir = 0;
			Else;
				Abort;
			End;
		End;
		Abort If(Attacker == Null);
		Abort If(Attacker == Event Player);
		Abort If(Player Variable(Attacker, Manusia) == False);
		Event Player.IndeksBalasDendam = Index Of Array Value(Event Player.PembunuhBalasDendam, Attacker);
		If(Event Player.IndeksBalasDendam < 0);
			Event Player.PembunuhBalasDendam = Append To Array(Event Player.PembunuhBalasDendam, Attacker);
			Event Player.JumlahBalasDendam = Append To Array(Event Player.JumlahBalasDendam, 1);
		Else;
			Modify Player Variable At Index(Event Player, JumlahBalasDendam, Event Player.IndeksBalasDendam, Add, 1);
		End;
	}
}

rule("18c - Kebal: Nonaktifkan hanya mode 1 HP di Ruang Muncul")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.ModeKebal == 1;
		Is In Spawn Room(Event Player) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.KebalAktif = False;
		Event Player.ModeKebal = 0;
		Event Player.KursorKebal = 1;
		Clear Status(Event Player, Unkillable);
		Set Damage Received(Event Player, 100);
		Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
		If(Is Alive(Event Player) == True);
			Set Player Health(Event Player, Max Health(Event Player));
		End;
		If(Event Player.IkonKebal != Null);
			Destroy Icon(Event Player.IkonKebal);
			Event Player.IkonKebal = Null;
			If(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player));
				Global.IkonKebalPemain[Global.SlotHUDPemain[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player)]] = 0;
			End;
		End;
		Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Unkillable: 1 HP (HEALABLE) off in Spawn Room.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Kebal 1 HP dimatikan di ruang muncul.") : Custom String("ปิดโหมด 1 HP (ฮีลได้) ในห้องเกิดแล้ว"));
	}
}
