}

rule("91q - Subrutin: Hitung ulang pilihan dan pemimpin tunggal")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		HitungPilihan;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Hitung dari pemilih yang masih terdaftar; jangan membaca variabel milik entitas yang sudah keluar."
		For Global Variable(IndeksPemilih, 0, Count Of(Global.PemainManusia), 1);
			Set Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], JumlahPilihan, Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.PemainManusia, Player Variable(Current Array Element, PemainDipilih) == Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih])));
		End;
		Global.PemimpinPilihan = Null;
		Global.PilihanTerbanyak = 0;
		Global.PilihanSeri = False;
		Global.NamaPemimpinPilihan = Custom String("");
		Global.WarnaPemimpinPilihan = Custom Color(255, 255, 255, 255);
		If(Count Of(Global.PemainManusia) > 0);
			Global.PemimpinPilihan = First Of(Sorted Array(Global.PemainManusia, 0 - Player Variable(Current Array Element, JumlahPilihan)));
			Global.PilihanTerbanyak = Player Variable(Global.PemimpinPilihan, JumlahPilihan);
			If(Global.PilihanTerbanyak > 0);
				Global.PilihanSeri = Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.PemainManusia, Player Variable(Current Array Element, JumlahPilihan) == Global.PilihanTerbanyak)) > 1;
				If(Global.PilihanSeri == True);
					Global.PemimpinPilihan = Null;
				End;
			Else;
				Global.PemimpinPilihan = Null;
			End;
		End;
		If(Global.PemimpinPilihan != Null);
			Global.NamaPemimpinPilihan = Player Variable(Global.PemimpinPilihan, NamaTampilan);
			Global.WarnaPemimpinPilihan = Player Variable(Global.PemimpinPilihan, WarnaNama);
		End;
	}
}

rule("93 - Subrutin: Mulai kamera dinamis di bahu kiri")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		MulaiKamera;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Event Player.TargetKamera == Null);
		Abort If(Entity Exists(Event Player.TargetKamera) == False);
		"Ikuti perpindahan target setiap bingkai tanpa penghalusan yang mengejar tujuan bergerak dan menimbulkan getaran."
		Start Camera(Event Player, Update Every Frame(First Of(Mapped Array(Array(Ray Cast Hit Position(Eye Position(Event Player.TargetKamera) + Vector(0, Min(0.750, Max(0.450, 0.450 + (Max Health(Event Player.TargetKamera) - 200) * 0.0006)), 0), Eye Position(Event Player.TargetKamera) + Vector(0, Min(0.750, Max(0.450, 0.450 + (Max Health(Event Player.TargetKamera) - 200) * 0.0006)), 0) - Facing Direction Of(Event Player.TargetKamera) * Min(4.500, Max(Global.JarakKamera, Global.JarakKamera + (Max Health(Event Player.TargetKamera) - 200) * 0.0055)) + Cross Product(Direction From Angles(Horizontal Facing Angle Of(Event Player.TargetKamera), 0), Vector(0, 1, 0)) * Min(1.350, Max(Global.GeserKamera, Global.GeserKamera + (Max Health(Event Player.TargetKamera) - 200) * 0.0016)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False)), Current Array Element + Direction Towards(Current Array Element, Eye Position(Event Player.TargetKamera) + Vector(0, Min(0.750, Max(0.450, 0.450 + (Max Health(Event Player.TargetKamera) - 200) * 0.0006)), 0)) * Min(Global.BantalanDinding, Distance Between(Current Array Element, Eye Position(Event Player.TargetKamera) + Vector(0, Min(0.750, Max(0.450, 0.450 + (Max Health(Event Player.TargetKamera) - 200) * 0.0006)), 0)) * 0.250)))), Update Every Frame(Eye Position(Event Player.TargetKamera) + Facing Direction Of(Event Player.TargetKamera) * Global.JarakBidik), 0);
	}
}

rule("93b2 - Subrutin: Tenangkan pemicu sebelum pembersihan")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TenangkanPemain;
	}

	actions
	{
		Global.PemainPukulanSuper = Remove From Array(Global.PemainPukulanSuper, Event Player);
		"Pulihkan efek mesin sebelum penyiapan menghapus variabel; hanya dipanggil dari konteks pemain pemicu."
		Call Subroutine(TutupMenu);
		Call Subroutine(BersihkanIkonPilar);
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Melee));
		Stop Camera(Event Player);
		Stop Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player);
		Stop Chasing Player Variable(Event Player, WarnaMenu);
		If(Event Player.LampiranTeleportasiAktif == True);
			Detach Players(Event Player);
		End;
		Event Player.LampiranTeleportasiAktif = False;
		Event Player.TargetLampiranTeleportasi = Null;
		Event Player.PahlawanLampiranSendiri = Null;
		Event Player.PahlawanLampiranTarget = Null;
		If(Event Player.PelatNamaDinonaktifkan == True);
			Enable Nameplates(All Players(All Teams), Event Player);
		End;
		Event Player.PelatNamaDinonaktifkan = False;
		Event Player.KebalAktif = False;
		Event Player.ModeKebal = 0;
		Event Player.KursorKebal = 0;
		Call Subroutine(PulihkanNasibPemain);
		Stop Accelerating(Event Player);
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Event Player);
		Set Move Speed(Event Player, 100);
		Set Gravity(Event Player, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Event Player);
		Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerikut = 0;
		Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerakhir = 0;
		Event Player.MenuNasibHarusDibuka = False;
		Event Player.KematianBalasDendam = False;
		Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam = Null;
		"Matikan semua pemicu sebelum acara keluar atau masuk menyelesaikan pembersihan dan pendaftaran baru."
		Event Player.SudahSiap = False;
		Event Player.Manusia = False;
		Event Player.PerintahMenu = 0;
		Event Player.MasukanMenuDikunci = False;
		Event Player.SeranganDekatDipakai = False;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka = False;
		Event Player.TeleportasiJongkokAktif = False;
		Event Player.PerintahTeleportasi = 0;
		Event Player.InspeksiAktif = False;
		Event Player.WaktuTeksTargetBerikut = 0;
		Event Player.BangkitPerluTeleportasi = False;
		Event Player.TargetInspeksi = Null;
		Event Player.InteraksiKameraDipakai = False;
		Event Player.IzinkanBotBuatanMengikuti = False;
		Event Player.WaktuTeleportasiBotBuatan = 0;
		Event Player.KursorTeleportasiBotBuatan = 0;
		Event Player.ModeHantuAktif = False;
		Event Player.ModeTerbangAktif = False;
		Event Player.KursorHantuTerbang = 0;
		Event Player.ModeLompatGanda = False;
		Event Player.KursorLompatGanda = 0;
		Event Player.TingkatLompatGanda = 1;
		Event Player.LompatGandaDipakai = False;
		Event Player.LompatDiTanah = True;
		Event Player.WaktuLompatGandaBerikut = 0;
		Event Player.PosisiIkonPilar = Vector(0, 0.500, 0);
		Event Player.FisikaHantuTerbangDiterapkan = False;
		Event Player.WaktuBunuhDiriBerikut = 0;
		Event Player.WaktuMulaiTerbangMaju = -1;
		Event Player.PersenTerbang = 100;
		Event Player.ArahTerbang = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Event Player.DeltaTerbang = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Event Player.RantaiLampiran = Null;
		Event Player.IndeksRantaiLampiran = 0;
		Event Player.SiklusLampiran = False;
		Event Player.HudKiri = Null;
		Event Player.HudMenu = Null;
		Event Player.HudPemainDibuat = False;
		Event Player.SudahDiperiksa = False;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis = False;
	}
}

rule("93c - Subrutin: Bersihkan referensi pemain yang benar-benar keluar")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		BersihkanPemain;
	}

	actions
	{
		Global.PemainPukulanSuper = Remove From Array(Global.PemainPukulanSuper, Event Player);
		"Pembersihan keluar hanya menyentuh pengenal dan daftar pemain global; entitas yang sudah hilang tidak dinormalisasi ulang."
		Global.PemainPembersihan = Event Player;
		Call Subroutine(BersihkanIkonPilar);
		Global.IndeksKeluar = Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Global.PemainPembersihan);
		If(Global.IndeksKeluar > -1);
			If(Or(Global.IndeksKeluar >= Count Of(Global.SlotHUDPemain), Or(Global.IndeksKeluar >= Count Of(Global.HudKiriPemain), Or(Global.IndeksKeluar >= Count Of(Global.HudMenuPemain), Global.IndeksKeluar >= Count Of(Global.TeksDuniaPemain)))));
				"Pengaman pembersihan: tandai jalur cadangan lalu jalankan pemulihan darurat setelah jalur utama."
				Global.IndeksPembersihan = Global.IndeksKeluar;
				Global.IndeksKeluar = -2;
			End;
			If(Global.IndeksKeluar >= 0);
				Global.IndeksPembersihan = Global.IndeksKeluar;
				Global.IndeksUtangKeluar = Global.SlotHUDPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan];
				If(Global.IkonKartuNasibPemain[Global.IndeksUtangKeluar] != 0);
					Destroy Icon(Global.IkonKartuNasibPemain[Global.IndeksUtangKeluar]);
				End;
				Global.IkonKartuNasibPemain[Global.IndeksUtangKeluar] = 0;
				If(Global.IkonKebalPemain[Global.IndeksUtangKeluar] != 0);
					Destroy Icon(Global.IkonKebalPemain[Global.IndeksUtangKeluar]);
				End;
				Global.IkonKebalPemain[Global.IndeksUtangKeluar] = 0;
				If(Global.PemainPembersihan.HudEfekNasib != Null);
					If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Global.PemainPembersihan) >= 0);
						If(Global.HudEfekSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Global.PemainPembersihan)] == Global.PemainPembersihan.HudEfekNasib);
							Destroy HUD Text(Global.PemainPembersihan.HudEfekNasib);
							Global.HudEfekSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Global.PemainPembersihan)] = 0;
						End;
					End;
				End;
				If(Global.PemainPembersihan.TeksVisiNasib != Null);
					If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Global.PemainPembersihan) >= 0);
						If(Global.TeksVisiSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Global.PemainPembersihan)] == Global.PemainPembersihan.TeksVisiNasib);
							Destroy In-World Text(Global.PemainPembersihan.TeksVisiNasib);
							Global.TeksVisiSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Global.PemainPembersihan)] = 0;
						End;
					End;
				End;
				If(Global.PemainPembersihan.TeksTeleportasi != Null);
					If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Global.PemainPembersihan) >= 0);
						If(Global.TeksTeleportasiSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Global.PemainPembersihan)] == Global.PemainPembersihan.TeksTeleportasi);
							Destroy In-World Text(Global.PemainPembersihan.TeksTeleportasi);
							Global.TeksTeleportasiSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Global.PemainPembersihan)] = 0;
						End;
					End;
				End;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.IkonKartuNasib = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.IkonKebal = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.HudEfekNasib = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.TeksVisiNasib = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.TeksTeleportasi = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.HudKiri = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.HudMenu = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.TeksDunia = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.HudPemainDibuat = False;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.SudahDiperiksa = False;
				"Hapus pilihan yang menunjuk pemain keluar sebelum slot entitas dapat dipakai ulang oleh orang lain."
				Set Player Variable(Filtered Array(Global.PemainManusia, Player Variable(Current Array Element, PemainDipilih) == Global.PemainPembersihan), PemainDipilih, Null);
				"Bersihkan pasangan utang dan klaim balas dendam sebelum referensi slot dapat dipakai ulang."
				For Global Variable(IndeksPemilih, 0, Count Of(Global.PemainManusia), 1);
					If(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih] != Global.PemainPembersihan);
						Global.IndeksDendamKeluar = Index Of Array Value(Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], PembunuhBalasDendam), Global.PemainPembersihan);
						If(And(Global.IndeksDendamKeluar >= 0, Global.IndeksDendamKeluar < Count Of(Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], JumlahBalasDendam))));
							Modify Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], PembunuhBalasDendam, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksDendamKeluar);
							Modify Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], JumlahBalasDendam, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksDendamKeluar);
						End;
						If(Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], TargetBalasDendamTerkunci) == Global.PemainPembersihan);
							Set Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, Null);
						End;
						If(Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], TargetBalasDendamDipilih) == Global.PemainPembersihan);
							Set Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], TargetBalasDendamDipilih, Null);
						End;
						If(Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], PenagihBalasDendam) == Global.PemainPembersihan);
							Set Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], PenagihBalasDendam, Null);
							Set Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], KematianBalasDendam, False);
							Set Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], WaktuPaksaBerikut, 0);
							Set Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], WaktuPaksaBerakhir, 0);
						End;
					End;
				End;
				If(Global.HudKiriPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan] != 0);
					Destroy HUD Text(Global.HudKiriPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]);
				End;
				If(Global.HudMenuPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan] != 0);
					Destroy HUD Text(Global.HudMenuPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]);
				End;
				If(Global.TeksDuniaPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan] != 0);
					Destroy In-World Text(Global.TeksDuniaPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]);
				End;
				Global.SlotHUDTersedia = Sorted Array(Append To Array(Global.SlotHUDTersedia, Global.IndeksUtangKeluar), Current Array Element);
				Modify Global Variable(HudKiriPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				Modify Global Variable(HudMenuPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				Modify Global Variable(TeksDuniaPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				Modify Global Variable(SlotHUDPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				Modify Global Variable(PemainManusia, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				Global.IndeksPemilih = Count Of(Global.SlotHUDPemain);
				Global.SlotHUDTerakhir = Global.IndeksPemilih == 0 ? -1 : Last Of(Sorted Array(Global.SlotHUDPemain, Current Array Element));
				Global.PilihanPerluDihitung = True;
			End;
			If(Global.IndeksKeluar == -2);
				If(Global.IndeksPembersihan < Count Of(Global.SlotHUDPemain));
					Destroy Icon(Global.IkonKartuNasibPemain[Global.SlotHUDPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]]);
					Global.IkonKartuNasibPemain[Global.SlotHUDPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]] = 0;
				End;
				If(Global.IndeksPembersihan < Count Of(Global.SlotHUDPemain));
					Destroy Icon(Global.IkonKebalPemain[Global.SlotHUDPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]]);
					Global.IkonKebalPemain[Global.SlotHUDPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]] = 0;
				End;
				If(Event Player.HudEfekNasib != Null);
					If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player) >= 0);
						If(Global.HudEfekSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player)] == Event Player.HudEfekNasib);
							Destroy HUD Text(Event Player.HudEfekNasib);
							Global.HudEfekSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player)] = 0;
						End;
					End;
				End;
				If(Event Player.TeksVisiNasib != Null);
					If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player) >= 0);
						If(Global.TeksVisiSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player)] == Event Player.TeksVisiNasib);
							Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.TeksVisiNasib);
							Global.TeksVisiSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player)] = 0;
						End;
					End;
				End;
				If(Event Player.TeksTeleportasi != Null);
					If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player) >= 0);
						If(Global.TeksTeleportasiSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player)] == Event Player.TeksTeleportasi);
							Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.TeksTeleportasi);
							Global.TeksTeleportasiSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player)] = 0;
						End;
					End;
				End;
				Event Player.IkonKartuNasib = Null;
				Event Player.IkonKebal = Null;
				Event Player.HudEfekNasib = Null;
				Event Player.TeksVisiNasib = Null;
				Event Player.TeksTeleportasi = Null;
				Event Player.HudKiri = Null;
				Event Player.HudMenu = Null;
				Event Player.TeksDunia = Null;
				Event Player.HudPemainDibuat = False;
				Event Player.SudahDiperiksa = False;
				If(Global.IndeksPembersihan < Count Of(Global.HudKiriPemain));
					If(Global.HudKiriPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan] != 0);
						Destroy HUD Text(Global.HudKiriPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]);
					End;
					Modify Global Variable(HudKiriPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				End;
				If(Global.IndeksPembersihan < Count Of(Global.HudMenuPemain));
					If(Global.HudMenuPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan] != 0);
						Destroy HUD Text(Global.HudMenuPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]);
					End;
					Modify Global Variable(HudMenuPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				End;
				If(Global.IndeksPembersihan < Count Of(Global.TeksDuniaPemain));
					If(Global.TeksDuniaPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan] != 0);
						Destroy In-World Text(Global.TeksDuniaPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]);
					End;
					Modify Global Variable(TeksDuniaPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				End;
				If(Global.IndeksPembersihan < Count Of(Global.SlotHUDPemain));
					Global.IndeksUtangKeluar = Global.SlotHUDPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan];
					Modify Global Variable(SlotHUDPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
					Global.SlotHUDTersedia = Append To Array(Global.SlotHUDTersedia, Global.IndeksUtangKeluar);
					Global.SlotHUDTersedia = Sorted Array(Global.SlotHUDTersedia, Current Array Element);
				End;
				Modify Global Variable(PemainManusia, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				Global.IndeksPemilih = Count Of(Global.SlotHUDPemain);
				Global.SlotHUDTerakhir = Global.IndeksPemilih == 0 ? -1 : Last Of(Sorted Array(Global.SlotHUDPemain, Current Array Element));
				Global.PilihanPerluDihitung = True;
			End;
		End;
		Global.PemainTeksPembersihan = Event Player;
		Call Subroutine(BersihkanTeksYatim);
		Global.IndeksKeluar = -1;
		Global.IndeksPembersihan = -1;
		Global.IndeksUtangKeluar = -1;
		Global.IndeksDendamKeluar = -1;
		Global.IndeksPemilih = 0;
		Global.PemainPembersihan = Null;
	}
}

rule("93d - Subrutin: Bersihkan teks yatim")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		BersihkanTeksYatim;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Daftar tetap 24 slot meliputi manusia dan bot; ID tetap tersedia setelah entitas hilang."
		For Global Variable(KursorTeksPembersihan, 0, Count Of(Global.PemilikTeksSementara), 1);
			If(Or(Global.PemilikTeksSementara[Global.KursorTeksPembersihan] != Null, Or(Global.HudEfekSementara[Global.KursorTeksPembersihan] != 0, Or(Global.TeksTeleportasiSementara[Global.KursorTeksPembersihan] != 0, Global.TeksVisiSementara[Global.KursorTeksPembersihan] != 0))));
			If(Or(Entity Exists(Global.PemilikTeksSementara[Global.KursorTeksPembersihan]) == False, And(Global.PemainTeksPembersihan != Null, Global.PemilikTeksSementara[Global.KursorTeksPembersihan] == Global.PemainTeksPembersihan)));
				If(Global.HudEfekSementara[Global.KursorTeksPembersihan] != 0);
					Destroy HUD Text(Global.HudEfekSementara[Global.KursorTeksPembersihan]);
				End;
				If(Global.TeksTeleportasiSementara[Global.KursorTeksPembersihan] != 0);
					Destroy In-World Text(Global.TeksTeleportasiSementara[Global.KursorTeksPembersihan]);
				End;
				If(Global.TeksVisiSementara[Global.KursorTeksPembersihan] != 0);
					Destroy In-World Text(Global.TeksVisiSementara[Global.KursorTeksPembersihan]);
				End;
				Global.HudEfekSementara[Global.KursorTeksPembersihan] = 0;
				Global.TeksTeleportasiSementara[Global.KursorTeksPembersihan] = 0;
				Global.TeksVisiSementara[Global.KursorTeksPembersihan] = 0;
				Global.PemilikTeksSementara[Global.KursorTeksPembersihan] = Null;
			End;
			End;
		End;
		Global.PemainTeksPembersihan = Null;
		Global.IndeksTeksPembersihan = -1;
		Global.KursorTeksPembersihan = 0;
	}
}

rule("94 - Subrutin: Siapkan pemain dari ujung rambut sampai variabel")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		SiapkanPemain;
	}

	{
		Abort If(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player));

		Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
		Stop Accelerating(Event Player);
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Event Player);
		Set Move Speed(Event Player, 100);
		Set Gravity(Event Player, 100);

rule("95 - Subrutin: Segarkan daftar tontonan, termasuk para bot")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		SegarkanTargetKamera;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(And(Event Player.KursorKamera >= 2, Event Player.KursorKamera - 2 < Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera)));
			Event Player.CalonTargetKamera = Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera[Event Player.KursorKamera - 2];
		Else;
			Event Player.CalonTargetKamera = Null;
		End;
		Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetPublikPemain);
		Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera = Filtered Array(Event Player.DaftarTargetInspeksi, Has Spawned(Current Array Element) == True);
		If(And(Event Player.CalonTargetKamera != Null, Array Contains(Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera, Event Player.CalonTargetKamera)));
			Event Player.KursorKamera = Index Of Array Value(Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera, Event Player.CalonTargetKamera) + 2;
		Else If(Event Player.KursorKamera >= Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera) + 2);
			Event Player.KursorKamera = 0;
		End;
	}
}

rule("96 - Subrutin: Cari target publik terdekat dari bidikan")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		SegarkanTargetInspeksi;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Or(Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi == Null, Or(Entity Exists(Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi) == False, Or(Has Spawned(Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi) == False, Or(Is Alive(Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi) == False, And(And(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi) == False, Player Variable(Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi, BotOtomatis) == False), Or(Player Variable(Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi, Manusia) == False, Or(Player Variable(Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi, PrivasiInspeksiAktif) == True, Player Variable(Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi, PembaruanDaftarTertunda) == True))))))));
			Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi = Null;
			Event Player.TargetInspeksi = Null;
		Else;
			Event Player.TargetInspeksi = Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi;
		End;
	}
}

rule("97 - Subrutin: Segarkan daftar target balas dendam")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		SegarkanTargetBalasDendam;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.KursorBalasDendam < Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam));
			Event Player.TargetBalasDendamDipilih = Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam[Event Player.KursorBalasDendam];
		Else;
			Event Player.TargetBalasDendamDipilih = Null;
		End;
		Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam = Filtered Array(Global.PemainManusia, Current Array Element != Event Player);
		If(Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam) == 0);
			Event Player.KursorBalasDendam = 0;
		Else If(And(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamDipilih != Null, Array Contains(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam, Event Player.TargetBalasDendamDipilih)));
			Event Player.KursorBalasDendam = Index Of Array Value(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam, Event Player.TargetBalasDendamDipilih);
		Else If(Event Player.KursorBalasDendam >= Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam));
			Event Player.KursorBalasDendam = 0;
		End;
	}
}

rule("98 - Subrutin: Cari target teleportasi publik terdekat dari bidikan")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		SegarkanTargetTeleportasi;
	}

	actions
	{
		Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetPublikPemain);
		Event Player.DaftarTargetTeleportasi = Event Player.DaftarTargetInspeksi;
		If(Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetTeleportasi) == 0);
			Event Player.CalonTargetTeleportasi = Null;
		Else;
			Event Player.CalonTargetTeleportasi = First Of(Sorted Array(Event Player.DaftarTargetTeleportasi, Angle Between Vectors(Facing Direction Of(Event Player), Direction Towards(Eye Position(Event Player), Eye Position(Current Array Element)))));
		End;
	}
}

rule("98a - Subrutin: Pulihkan status Nasib untuk pemain pemicu")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		PulihkanNasibPemain;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.IkonKartuNasib != Null);
			Destroy Icon(Event Player.IkonKartuNasib);
		End;
		If(Event Player.HudEfekNasib != Null);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player) >= 0);
				If(Global.HudEfekSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player)] == Event Player.HudEfekNasib);
					Destroy HUD Text(Event Player.HudEfekNasib);
					Global.HudEfekSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player)] = 0;
				End;
			End;
		End;
		If(Event Player.TeksVisiNasib != Null);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player) >= 0);
				If(Global.TeksVisiSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player)] == Event Player.TeksVisiNasib);
					Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.TeksVisiNasib);
					Global.TeksVisiSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Event Player)] = 0;
				End;
			End;
		End;
		Event Player.IkonKartuNasib = Null;
		If(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player));
			Global.IkonKartuNasibPemain[Global.SlotHUDPemain[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player)]] = 0;
		End;
		Event Player.HudEfekNasib = Null;
		Event Player.TeksVisiNasib = Null;
		Clear Status(Event Player, Burning);
		Clear Status(Event Player, Hacked);
		Clear Status(Event Player, Unkillable);
		If(Event Player.EfekNasib == 2);
			Stop Accelerating(Event Player);
			Set Move Speed(Event Player, 100);
		End;
		Set Damage Received(Event Player, 100);
		Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
		Set Jump Vertical Speed(Event Player, 100);
		Set Projectile Speed(Event Player, 100);
		Event Player.KartuNasibAktif = False;
		Event Player.PutaranKartuNasib = 0;
		Event Player.JedaKartuNasib = 0;
		Event Player.EfekNasib = 0;
		Event Player.EfekNasibBerakhir = 0;
		Event Player.PrivasiNasibAktif = False;
		Event Player.WaktuBakarNasibBerikut = 0;
		Event Player.WaktuPutaranNasibBerikut = 0;
		Event Player.WaktuIkonNasibBerakhir = 0;
		Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerikut = 0;
		Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerakhir = 0;
		Event Player.MenuNasibHarusDibuka = False;
		Event Player.KebalAktif = Event Player.ModeKebal != 0;
		Event Player.MasukanMenuDikunci = False;
		Event Player.PerintahMenu = 0;
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Interact));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Reload));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 1));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 2));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ultimate));
	}
}

rule("98b - Subrutin: Pulihkan status Nasib untuk pemain aktif global")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		PulihkanNasibAktif;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Or(Global.PemainAktif == Null, Entity Exists(Global.PemainAktif) == False));
		If(Global.PemainAktif.IkonKartuNasib != Null);
			Destroy Icon(Global.PemainAktif.IkonKartuNasib);
		End;
		If(Global.PemainAktif.HudEfekNasib != Null);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Global.PemainAktif) >= 0);
				If(Global.HudEfekSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Global.PemainAktif)] == Global.PemainAktif.HudEfekNasib);
					Destroy HUD Text(Global.PemainAktif.HudEfekNasib);
					Global.HudEfekSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Global.PemainAktif)] = 0;
				End;
			End;
		End;
		If(Global.PemainAktif.TeksVisiNasib != Null);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Global.PemainAktif) >= 0);
				If(Global.TeksVisiSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Global.PemainAktif)] == Global.PemainAktif.TeksVisiNasib);
					Destroy In-World Text(Global.PemainAktif.TeksVisiNasib);
					Global.TeksVisiSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, Global.PemainAktif)] = 0;
				End;
			End;
		End;
		Global.PemainAktif.IkonKartuNasib = Null;
		If(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Global.PemainAktif));
			Global.IkonKartuNasibPemain[Global.SlotHUDPemain[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Global.PemainAktif)]] = 0;
		End;
		Global.PemainAktif.HudEfekNasib = Null;
		Global.PemainAktif.TeksVisiNasib = Null;
		Clear Status(Global.PemainAktif, Burning);
		Clear Status(Global.PemainAktif, Hacked);
		If(Or(Global.PemainAktif.ModeKebal == 0, Is Alive(Global.PemainAktif) == False));
			Clear Status(Global.PemainAktif, Unkillable);
			Set Damage Received(Global.PemainAktif, 100);
			Set Knockback Received(Global.PemainAktif, 100);
			Enable Movement Collision With Players(Global.PemainAktif);
		End;
		If(Global.PemainAktif.EfekNasib == 2);
			Stop Accelerating(Global.PemainAktif);
			Set Move Speed(Global.PemainAktif, 100);
		End;
		Set Jump Vertical Speed(Global.PemainAktif, 100);
		Set Projectile Speed(Global.PemainAktif, 100);
		Global.PemainAktif.KartuNasibAktif = False;
		Global.PemainAktif.PutaranKartuNasib = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.JedaKartuNasib = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.EfekNasib = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.EfekNasibBerakhir = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.PrivasiNasibAktif = False;
		Global.PemainAktif.WaktuBakarNasibBerikut = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.WaktuPutaranNasibBerikut = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.WaktuIkonNasibBerakhir = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.WaktuPaksaBerikut = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.WaktuPaksaBerakhir = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.MenuNasibHarusDibuka = False;
		Global.PemainAktif.KebalAktif = Global.PemainAktif.ModeKebal != 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.MasukanMenuDikunci = False;
		Global.PemainAktif.PerintahMenu = 0;
		Allow Button(Global.PemainAktif, Button(Primary Fire));
		Allow Button(Global.PemainAktif, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Allow Button(Global.PemainAktif, Button(Interact));
		Allow Button(Global.PemainAktif, Button(Reload));
		Allow Button(Global.PemainAktif, Button(Ability 1));
		Allow Button(Global.PemainAktif, Button(Ability 2));
		Allow Button(Global.PemainAktif, Button(Ultimate));
	}
}

rule("98c - Subrutin: Segarkan daftar target publik untuk pemain pemicu")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		SegarkanTargetPublikPemain;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.DaftarTargetInspeksi = Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), And(Current Array Element != Event Player, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Is Alive(Current Array Element), Or(Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True, Or(Player Variable(Current Array Element, BotOtomatis) == True, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, Manusia) == True, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, PrivasiInspeksiAktif) == False, Player Variable(Current Array Element, PembaruanDaftarTertunda) == False))))))));
	}
}

rule("98d - Subrutin: Segarkan daftar target publik untuk pemain aktif global")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		SegarkanTargetPublikAktif;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Or(Global.PemainAktif == Null, Entity Exists(Global.PemainAktif) == False));
		Set Player Variable(Global.PemainAktif, DaftarTargetInspeksi, Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), And(Current Array Element != Global.PemainAktif, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Is Alive(Current Array Element), Or(Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True, Or(Player Variable(Current Array Element, BotOtomatis) == True, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, Manusia) == True, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, PrivasiInspeksiAktif) == False, Player Variable(Current Array Element, PembaruanDaftarTertunda) == False)))))))));
	}
}

rule("98e - Subrutin: Buat bot buatan sesuai tim aktif")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		BuatBotBuatanTim;
	}

	actions
	{
		Create Dummy Bot(All Heroes, Global.TimBotBuatanAktif, -1, Position Of(First Of(Spawn Points(Global.TimBotBuatanAktif))), Vector(0, 0, 1));
	}
}

rule("98f - Subrutin: Lepas bot buatan sesuai tim aktif")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		LepasBotBuatanTim;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.TimBotBuatanAktif), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)) == 0);
		If(Player Variable(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.TimBotBuatanAktif), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)), TeksVisiNasib) != Null);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.TimBotBuatanAktif), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True))) >= 0);
				If(Global.TeksVisiSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.TimBotBuatanAktif), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)))] == Player Variable(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.TimBotBuatanAktif), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)), TeksVisiNasib));
					Destroy In-World Text(Player Variable(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.TimBotBuatanAktif), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)), TeksVisiNasib));
					Global.TeksVisiSementara[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemilikTeksSementara, First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.TimBotBuatanAktif), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)))] = 0;
				End;
			End;
		End;
		Stop Facing(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.TimBotBuatanAktif), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)));
		Stop Throttle In Direction(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.TimBotBuatanAktif), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)));
		Destroy Dummy Bot(Global.TimBotBuatanAktif, Slot Of(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.TimBotBuatanAktif), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True))));
	}
}

rule("98g - Subrutin: Teleportasi ke ruang muncul")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TeleportasiKeRuangMuncul;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Is In Spawn Room(Event Player) == True);
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Already in Spawn Room. Home sweet home!") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Sudah di ruang muncul. Beres!") : Custom String("อยู่ในห้องเกิดแล้ว ถึงที่หมาย!"));
		Else If(Count Of(Spawn Points(Team Of(Event Player))) == 0);
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Spawn Room unavailable.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Ruang muncul belum tersedia di peta ini.") : Custom String("ห้องเกิดในแผนที่นี้ยังไม่พร้อม"));
		Else;
			Teleport(Event Player, Position Of(First Of(Spawn Points(Team Of(Event Player)))));
		End;
	}
}

rule("98h - Subrutin: Teleportasi ke objektif")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TeleportasiKeObjektif;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.PosisiTujuanTeleportasi = Objective Position(Objective Index);
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiTujuanTeleportasi, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Objective unavailable.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Posisi objektif belum tersedia.") : Custom String("จุดภารกิจยังไม่พร้อม"));
			Abort;
		End;
		Call Subroutine(CariPosisiTeleportasiAman);
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("No safe walkable spot near the objective.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Tak ada pijakan aman dekat objektif.") : Custom String("ไม่มีจุดเดินที่ปลอดภัยใกล้ภารกิจ"));
			Abort;
		End;
		Teleport(Event Player, Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman);
	}
}

rule("98i - Subrutin: Teleportasi ke target pemain")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TeleportasiKeTarget;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Or(Or(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci == Null, Entity Exists(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) == False), Or(Is Alive(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) == False, Array Contains(Event Player.DaftarTargetTeleportasi, Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) == False)));
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Target unavailable. Teleport has standards.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Target tak tersedia. Teleportasi ikut rehat!") : Custom String("เป้าหมายไม่พร้อม วาร์ปพักก่อน!"));
			Abort;
		End;
		Event Player.PosisiTujuanTeleportasi = Position Of(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) - Facing Direction Of(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) * 2.250;
		Call Subroutine(CariPosisiTeleportasiAman);
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiTujuanTeleportasi = Position Of(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) + Facing Direction Of(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) * 2.250;
			Call Subroutine(CariPosisiTeleportasiAman);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiTujuanTeleportasi = Position Of(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) + Vector(2.250, 0, 0);
			Call Subroutine(CariPosisiTeleportasiAman);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiTujuanTeleportasi = Position Of(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) + Vector(-2.250, 0, 0);
			Call Subroutine(CariPosisiTeleportasiAman);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiTujuanTeleportasi = Position Of(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) + Vector(0, 0, 2.250);
			Call Subroutine(CariPosisiTeleportasiAman);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiTujuanTeleportasi = Position Of(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) + Vector(0, 0, -2.250);
			Call Subroutine(CariPosisiTeleportasiAman);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("No safe walkable spot near that target.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Tak ada pijakan aman dekat target itu.") : Custom String("ไม่มีจุดเดินที่ปลอดภัยใกล้เป้าหมาย"));
			Abort;
		End;
		Teleport(Event Player, Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman);
	}
}

rule("98j - Subrutin: Cari posisi teleportasi aman")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		CariPosisiTeleportasiAman;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiTujuanTeleportasi, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
		Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.PosisiTujuanTeleportasi);
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		"Jauhkan titik teleportasi dari dinding sebelum memeriksa tanah dan jalur akhir."
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(1.500, 1, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 1.250);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(-1.500, 0, 0));
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(-1.500, 1, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 1.250);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(1.500, 0, 0));
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 1.500), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 1.250);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 0, -1.500));
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, -1.500), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 1.250);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 0, 1.500));
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(1.000, 1, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 0.850);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(-1.000, 1, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 0.850);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 1.000), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 0.850);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, -1.000), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 0.850);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 0.250, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 2.500, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 0.250, 0)) < 2.000);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Event Player.PosisiTujuanTeleportasi) > 8);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 5, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman - Vector(0, 20, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman) > 6);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiTujuanTeleportasi + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) > 0.750);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
			"Periksa lagi ruang badan dan kepala setelah semua koreksi dinding; titik sempit dibatalkan agar pemanggil mencoba posisi lain."
			If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(1.500, 1.000, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 0)) < 1.250);
				Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
				Abort;
			End;
			If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(-1.500, 1.000, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 0)) < 1.250);
				Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
				Abort;
			End;
			If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 1.500), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 0)) < 1.250);
				Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
				Abort;
			End;
			If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, -1.500), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 0)) < 1.250);
				Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
				Abort;
			End;
			If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 0.500, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 2.750, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 0.500, 0)) < 2.000);
				Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
				Abort;
			End;
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman += Vector(0, 0.500, 0);
		End;
	}
}

rule("99p - Subrutin: Terapkan pilihan lompat ganda")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanLompatGanda;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.KursorLompatGanda %= 11;
		Event Player.ModeLompatGanda = Event Player.KursorLompatGanda != 0;
		If(Event Player.ModeLompatGanda == True);
			Event Player.TingkatLompatGanda = Event Player.KursorLompatGanda;
		End;
		"Saat mode diterapkan, tombol yang sudah ditahan menunggu jeda sebelum lompatan udara berikutnya."
		Event Player.LompatGandaDipakai = Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Jump));
		Event Player.LompatDiTanah = Is On Ground(Event Player);
		Event Player.WaktuLompatGandaBerikut = Total Time Elapsed + 0.300;
	}
}

rule("91t - Subrutin: Gambar pilihan lompat ganda")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		GambarLompatGanda;
	}

	actions
	{
		Create HUD Text(Event Player, Null,
			Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Custom String("Hold CROUCH | {0}: next | {1}: prev", Input Binding String(Button(Primary Fire)), Input Binding String(Button(Secondary Fire))), Custom String("{0}: apply | {1}: back", Input Binding String(Button(Interact)), Input Binding String(Button(Reload)))) : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Custom String("Tahan JONGKOK | {0}: maju | {1}: mundur", Input Binding String(Button(Primary Fire)), Input Binding String(Button(Secondary Fire))), Custom String("{0}: pakai | {1}: kembali", Input Binding String(Button(Interact)), Input Binding String(Button(Reload)))) : Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Custom String("ย่อค้าง | {0}: ถัดไป | {1}: ก่อนหน้า", Input Binding String(Button(Primary Fire)), Input Binding String(Button(Secondary Fire))), Custom String("{0}: ใช้ | {1}: กลับ", Input Binding String(Button(Interact)), Input Binding String(Button(Reload)))),
			Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("{0}\n> {1}", Custom String("14 - MULTIJUMP {0}/11\nNOW: {1} | AIR BOOST: {2}%", Event Player.KursorLompatGanda + 1, Event Player.ModeLompatGanda ? Custom String("ON") : Custom String("OFF"), Event Player.TingkatLompatGanda * 100), Event Player.KursorLompatGanda == 0 ? Custom String("OFF") : Custom String("AIR BOOST: {0}%\nIN AIR: TAP / HOLD JUMP", Event Player.KursorLompatGanda * 100)) : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("{0}\n> {1}", Custom String("14 - LOMPAT BERULANG {0}/11\nKINI: {1} | DORONGAN UDARA: {2}%", Event Player.KursorLompatGanda + 1, Event Player.ModeLompatGanda ? Custom String("AKTIF") : Custom String("MATI"), Event Player.TingkatLompatGanda * 100), Event Player.KursorLompatGanda == 0 ? Custom String("MATI") : Custom String("DORONGAN UDARA: {0}%\nDI UDARA: TEKAN / TAHAN LOMPAT", Event Player.KursorLompatGanda * 100)) : Custom String("{0}\n> {1}", Custom String("14 - กระโดดหลายครั้ง {0}/11\nสถานะ: {1} | แรงกลางอากาศ: {2}%", Event Player.KursorLompatGanda + 1, Event Player.ModeLompatGanda ? Custom String("เปิด") : Custom String("ปิด"), Event Player.TingkatLompatGanda * 100), Event Player.KursorLompatGanda == 0 ? Custom String("ปิด") : Custom String("แรงกลางอากาศ: {0}%\nกลางอากาศ: แตะ / กดกระโดดค้าง", Event Player.KursorLompatGanda * 100)),
			Top, 3, Color(White), Custom Color(215, 235, 255, 255), Custom Color(X Component Of(Event Player.WarnaMenu), Y Component Of(Event Player.WarnaMenu), Z Component Of(Event Player.WarnaMenu), 255), Visible To String and Color, Visible Never);
		Event Player.HudMenu = Last Text ID;
	}
}

rule("89h - Subrutin: Lompat udara berulang dengan jeda")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProsesLompatGanda;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Is Button Held(Global.PemainAktif, Button(Jump)) == True);
			If(Or(Global.PemainAktif.LompatGandaDipakai == False, Total Time Elapsed >= Global.PemainAktif.WaktuLompatGandaBerikut));
				Global.PemainAktif.WaktuLompatGandaBerikut = Total Time Elapsed + 0.300;
				If(And(Global.PemainAktif.Manusia == True, And(Has Spawned(Global.PemainAktif) == True, And(Is Alive(Global.PemainAktif) == True, And(Global.PemainAktif.ModeTerbangAktif == False, And(Global.PemainAktif.LampiranTeleportasiAktif == False, And(Global.PemainAktif.BangkitLompatDipakai == False, And(Or(Global.PemainAktif.EfekNasib != 2, Global.PemainAktif.EfekNasibBerakhir <= Total Time Elapsed), Or(Global.PemainAktif.LompatGandaDipakai == False, And(Global.PemainAktif.LompatDiTanah == False, Is On Ground(Global.PemainAktif) == False))))))))));
					Global.PemainAktif.LompatGandaDipakai = True;
					"Koreksi kecepatan vertikal tetap; tombol ditahan mengulang hanya di udara setiap 0.300 detik."
					If(And(Global.PemainAktif.LompatDiTanah == False, Is On Ground(Global.PemainAktif) == False));
						Apply Impulse(Global.PemainAktif, 6 * Global.PemainAktif.TingkatLompatGanda - Y Component Of(Velocity Of(Global.PemainAktif)) >= 0 ? Vector(0, 1, 0) : Vector(0, -1, 0), Absolute Value(6 * Global.PemainAktif.TingkatLompatGanda - Y Component Of(Velocity Of(Global.PemainAktif))), To World, Incorporate Contrary Motion);
					End;
					Play Effect(All Players(All Teams), Ring Explosion, Global.RGB, Position Of(Global.PemainAktif) + Vector(0, 0.050, 0), 1.500);
				Else;
					Global.PemainAktif.LompatGandaDipakai = True;
				End;
			End;
		Else;
			Global.PemainAktif.LompatGandaDipakai = False;
			Global.PemainAktif.WaktuLompatGandaBerikut = 0;
		End;
		Global.PemainAktif.LompatDiTanah = Is On Ground(Global.PemainAktif);
	}
}

rule("99q - Subrutin: Terapkan sakelar pukulan super")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanPukulanSuper;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) == False);
		Abort If(Or(Event Player.UrutanHUD < 0, Event Player.UrutanHUD >= 12));
		If(Array Contains(Global.PemainPukulanSuper, Event Player));
			Modify Global Variable(PemainPukulanSuper, Remove From Array By Value, Event Player);
			Global.WaktuPukulanSuper[Event Player.UrutanHUD] = 0;
		Else;
			Modify Global Variable(PemainPukulanSuper, Append To Array, Event Player);
			"Tombol serangan yang sudah ditahan harus dilepas sebelum pukulan baru."
			Global.WaktuPukulanSuper[Event Player.UrutanHUD] = -1;
		End;
	}
}

rule("89i - Subrutin: Pukulan super sekali per ayunan")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProsesPukulanSuper;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Or(Global.PemainAktif.UrutanHUD < 0, Global.PemainAktif.UrutanHUD >= Count Of(Global.WaktuPukulanSuper)));
		If(Is Meleeing(Global.PemainAktif) == False);
			Global.WaktuPukulanSuper[Global.PemainAktif.UrutanHUD] = 0;
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Or(Global.PemainAktif.Manusia == False, Or(Global.PemainAktif.BotOtomatis == True, Or(Is Dummy Bot(Global.PemainAktif) == True, Or(Entity Exists(Global.PemainAktif) == False, Or(Has Spawned(Global.PemainAktif) == False, Or(Is Alive(Global.PemainAktif) == False, Or(Global.PemainAktif.SiklusPemainAktif == True, Or(Global.PemainAktif.PindahTimDiproses == True, Global.PemainAktif.SeranganDekatDipakai == True)))))))));
			Global.WaktuPukulanSuper[Global.PemainAktif.UrutanHUD] = -1;
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Global.WaktuPukulanSuper[Global.PemainAktif.UrutanHUD] == 0);
			"Cari selama ayunan nyata tanpa jeda; ayunan kosong tidak menghabiskan pukulan."
			Global.TargetPukulanSuper = First Of(Sorted Array(Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), And(Current Array Element != Global.PemainAktif, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Has Spawned(Current Array Element), And(Is Alive(Current Array Element), And(Distance Between(Position Of(Global.PemainAktif), Position Of(Current Array Element)) <= 2.500, And(Is In View Angle(Global.PemainAktif, Eye Position(Current Array Element), 90), Is In Line Of Sight(Eye Position(Global.PemainAktif), Eye Position(Current Array Element), Barriers Do Not Block LOS)))))))), Distance Between(Position Of(Global.PemainAktif), Position Of(Current Array Element))));
			If(Global.TargetPukulanSuper != Null);
				"Satu sasaran per ayunan; perlindungan tetap menghabiskan kontak ini."
				Global.WaktuPukulanSuper[Global.PemainAktif.UrutanHUD] = -1;
			End;
			If(And(Global.TargetPukulanSuper != Null, And(Entity Exists(Global.TargetPukulanSuper), And(Has Spawned(Global.TargetPukulanSuper), And(Is Alive(Global.TargetPukulanSuper), And(Has Status(Global.TargetPukulanSuper, Phased Out) == False, And(Has Status(Global.TargetPukulanSuper, Unkillable) == False, Or(Player Variable(Global.TargetPukulanSuper, KebalAktif) == False, Player Variable(Global.TargetPukulanSuper, ModeKebal) == 0))))))));
				Kill(Global.TargetPukulanSuper, Global.PemainAktif);
			End;
			Global.TargetPukulanSuper = Null;
		End;
	}
}

rule("89i1 - Pukulan super: Dampak jarak dekat asli")
{
	event
	{
		Player Dealt Damage;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Array Contains(Global.PemainPukulanSuper, Event Player) == True;
		Event Ability == Button(Melee);
		Hero Of(Event Player) != Hero(Junker Queen);
		Event Damage > 0;
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Entity Exists(Event Player) == True;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.SiklusPemainAktif == False;
		Event Player.PindahTimDiproses == False;
		Event Player.SeranganDekatDipakai == False;
		Victim != Null;
		Victim != Event Player;
		Entity Exists(Victim) == True;
		Has Spawned(Victim) == True;
		Is Alive(Victim) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Dampak asli tidak bergantung pada sampel animasi atau pemain sementara penjadwal."
		Abort If(Or(Event Player.UrutanHUD < 0, Event Player.UrutanHUD >= Count Of(Global.WaktuPukulanSuper)));
		Abort If(Global.WaktuPukulanSuper[Event Player.UrutanHUD] < 0);
		Global.WaktuPukulanSuper[Event Player.UrutanHUD] = -1;
		If(And(Has Status(Victim, Phased Out) == False, And(Has Status(Victim, Unkillable) == False, Or(Player Variable(Victim, KebalAktif) == False, Player Variable(Victim, ModeKebal) == 0))));
			Kill(Victim, Event Player);
		End;
	}
}

rule("89e - Subrutin: Rawat ikon mengambang di tujuan satu kali per detik")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		PerbaruiPilarSosial;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Dua belas slot tetap; pemilik lama selalu dilepas sebelum slot dipakai ulang."
		For Global Variable(IndeksIkonPilar, 0, 12, 1);
			If(And(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] != Null, And(Entity Exists(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar]), And(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar]), And(Player Variable(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar], Manusia) == True, And(Player Variable(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar], PembaruanDaftarTertunda) == False, And(Player Variable(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar], PindahTimDiproses) == False, Player Variable(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar], IndeksIkon) > 0))))) == False));
				If(Global.EntitasIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] != 0);
					Destroy Icon(Global.EntitasIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar]);
				End;
				If(Entity Exists(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar]));
					Stop Chasing Player Variable(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar], PosisiIkonPilar);
					Set Player Variable(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar], PosisiIkonPilar, Vector(0, 0.500, 0));
				End;
				Global.EntitasIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] = 0;
				Global.PilihanIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] = 0;
				Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] = Null;
				Global.WaktuIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] = 0;
			End;
			If(And(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] == Null, Distance Between(Objective Position(Objective Index), Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100));
				Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] = First Of(Filtered Array(Global.PemainManusia, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, UrutanHUD) == Global.IndeksIkonPilar, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Current Array Element), And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, Manusia) == True, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, PembaruanDaftarTertunda) == False, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, PindahTimDiproses) == False, Player Variable(Current Array Element, IndeksIkon) > 0))))))));
				If(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] != Null);
					Set Player Variable(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar], PosisiIkonPilar, Direction From Angles(Random Real(0, 360), 0) * Random Real(0, 10) + Vector(0, Random Real(0.500, 8), 0));
					Global.WaktuIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] = Total Time Elapsed;
					Chase Player Variable Over Time(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar], PosisiIkonPilar, Direction From Angles(Random Real(0, 360), 0) * Random Real(0, 10) + Vector(0, Random Real(0.500, 8), 0), 4.500, None);
				End;
			End;
			If(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] != Null);
				If(Total Time Elapsed >= Global.WaktuIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] + 3);
					"Tujuan baru dimulai dari posisi saat ini sebelum lintasan selesai; pemeriksaan tetap satu detik."
					Global.WaktuIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] = Total Time Elapsed;
					Chase Player Variable Over Time(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar], PosisiIkonPilar, Direction From Angles(Random Real(0, 360), 0) * Random Real(0, 10) + Vector(0, Random Real(0.500, 8), 0), 4.500, None);
				End;
				"Jenis ikon asli diganti hanya saat pilihan berubah; warna terus mengikuti pemilik."
				If(Global.PilihanIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] != Player Variable(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar], IndeksIkon));
					If(Global.EntitasIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] != 0);
						Destroy Icon(Global.EntitasIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar]);
					End;
					Global.EntitasIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] = 0;
					Global.PilihanIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] = Player Variable(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar], IndeksIkon);
				End;
				Global.PemainIkonPilar = Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar];
				If(Global.EntitasIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] == 0);
					If(Global.PilihanIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] == 1);
						Create Icon(And(And(Entity Exists(Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar)), And(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar)), And(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar), Manusia) == True, Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar), IndeksIkon) == 1))), Distance Between(Objective Position(Objective Index), Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100) ? All Players(All Teams) : Empty Array, Objective Position(Objective Index) + Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar), PosisiIkonPilar), Arrow: Down, Visible To Position and Color, Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar), WarnaNama), False);
					Else If(Global.PilihanIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] == 2);
						Create Icon(And(And(Entity Exists(Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar)), And(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar)), And(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar), Manusia) == True, Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar), IndeksIkon) == 2))), Distance Between(Objective Position(Objective Index), Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100) ? All Players(All Teams) : Empty Array, Objective Position(Objective Index) + Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar), PosisiIkonPilar), Arrow: Left, Visible To Position and Color, Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar), WarnaNama), False);
					Else If(Global.PilihanIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] == 3);
						Create Icon(And(And(Entity Exists(Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar)), And(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar)), And(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar), Manusia) == True, Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar), IndeksIkon) == 3))), Distance Between(Objective Position(Objective Index), Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100) ? 					Else If(Global.PilihanIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] == 4);
						Create Icon(And(And(Entity Exists(Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar)), And(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar)), And(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar), Manusia) == True, Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.PemainIkonPilar), IndeksIkon) == 4))), Distance Between(Objective Position(Objective Index), Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100) ? rule("93e - Subrutin: Lepas ikon tujuan saat keluar atau berganti tim")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		BersihkanIkonPilar;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Pembersihan memakai registri global dan tetap aman saat entitas pemain telah hilang."
		For Global Variable(IndeksIkonPilar, 0, 12, 1);
			If(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] == Event Player);
				If(Global.EntitasIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] != 0);
					Destroy Icon(Global.EntitasIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar]);
				End;
				If(Entity Exists(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar]));
					Stop Chasing Player Variable(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar], PosisiIkonPilar);
					Set Player Variable(Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar], PosisiIkonPilar, Vector(0, 0.500, 0));
				End;
				Global.EntitasIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] = 0;
				Global.PilihanIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] = 0;
				Global.PemilikIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] = Null;
				Global.WaktuIkonPilar[Global.IndeksIkonPilar] = 0;
			End;
		End;
	}
}
